okkāppi: (Okapi) oṭṭaic civiṅkikku iṉamuḷḷa vilaṅku; mattiya āppirikkāviluḷḷa kāṭukaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭuvatu. itaṉ kālkaḷum kaḻuttum oṭṭaicciviṅkik kiruppataiviṭak kuṭṭaiyāṉavai. itaṉ tōḷarukil 5 aṭi uyaramirukkum.
oppōcam: (Opossum) kaṅkāruvaippōl aṭi vayiṟṟiṟ pāṟpaiyuḷḷa pūṉaiyaḷaviṉatākiya ciṟuvilaṅku. itu vaṭa amerikkāviṟ kāṇap paṭukiṉṟatu. itaṉ kuṭṭi piṟakkumpōtu 4 kuṉṟimaṇi eṭaiyuḷḷatāka virukkum. oppōcam kōḻi, aṇil mutaliyavaṟṟaip piṭittut tiṉṉum. itai etirttāl cettuppōṉatu pōlap pācāṅku ceyyum.
kaṅkāru: ā°tirēliyāviṟ kāṇappaṭum vilaṅku. itaṉ peṇṇiṉ aṭivayiṟṟiṟ pāṟpai uṇṭu. itaṉ piṉṉaṅkālkaḷ muṉṉaṅkāl kaḷilum nīḷamāṉavai. kaṅkāru piṉṉaṅkālkaḷāl tāvip patiṉaintaṭi tūram pāyntu vēkamākac cellum.
kaṭalil vāḻum pālūṭṭikaḷ: vālra° (Walrus), kaṭal nāy (Seal,) kaṭaṟpacu, timiṅkilam, kaṭaṟciṅkam, kaṭal yāṉai mutaliyaṉa.
karaṭi: nāy, ōnāy, nari eṉpavaṟṟukku iṉamuṭaiyatu. karaṭiyiṟ perumpālāṉa kiḻaṅku, tēṉ mutaliyavaṟṟai uṇṇum. amerikkāviṟ kāṇappaṭum cāmpal niṟakkaraṭiyum vaṭa turuvappakutikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭum veḷḷaik karaṭiyum mīṉ, naṇṭu vakaikaḷ, kaṭaṟpaṟavaikaḷai uṇṇum.
kaṟpaṭi uruvam: (Fossil) pāṟaikaḷil kāṇappaṭum mikappaḻaṅkālattiya tāvaraṅkaḷ, paṟavaikaḷ, vilaṅkukaḷ, pallikaḷ, pūccikaḷiṉ uruvaṅkaḷ. ivaṟṟaik koṇṭu paḻaṅkāla uyir vakaikaḷaippaṟṟi viññāṉikaḷ ārāycci naṭattuvar.
bkāṟikkum pirāṇikaḷ: eli, aṇil, muyal mutaliyaṉa mukkiya koṟikkum pirāṇikaḷ. koṟippatiṉāluṇṭākum palliṉ tēyvukaḷ vaḷarntu koṇṭirukkum.
kōlā: itu pāṟpaiyuḷḷa ā°tirēliya karaṭi. itu ilaikaḷait tiṉṟu yūkālipṭa° maraṅkaḷil vāḻum.
kuḷiroṭukkam (Hibernation): muḷḷeli, veḷavāl, cuṇṭeli, karaṭi pōṉṟa cila pirāṇikaḷ mārikālan toṭaṅkumpōtu kuḷiroṭukkat tukkuc celkiṉṟaṉa. appoḻutu uṭaliṉ veppanilai ciṟitu viḻukiṟatu. pirāṇi acaiviṉṟik kiṭakkiṉṟatu. nāṭittuṭippu māttiram teḷivākavirukkum. kuḷirkālaṅ kaḻintatum avai maṟupaṭiyum viḻitteḻuntu cuṟucuṟuppaṭaikiṉṟaṉa.
tārāmūkku eli: ā°tirēliyāvilum tā°mēṉiyāvilum kāṇappaṭum oruvakai eli; 20 aṅkula nīḷamuḷḷatu; muṭṭaiyiṭuvatu; kuṭṭikkup pāl koṭuppatu. itaṉ mūkkut tārāviṉ mūkkup pōṉṟatu.
nāy: itu nari, ōnāy mutaliyavaṟṟukku iṉamuṭaiyatu. vaḷarkkum nāy ōnāyiṉ cantatiyiliruntu vantatu.
nīrnāy: itu nīril nīnti mīṉkaḷaip piṭittut tiṉṉum vilaṅku; vīcal (Weasel), pāṭcar, (Badger) eṉṉum vilaṅkukaḷukku iṉamuṭaiyatu. itaṟkuc cavviṇaippuḷḷa viralkaḷuṇṭu.
nīla ōnāy: itaṟku artvulp (Aardwolf) eṉṉum peyar iṭaccu moḻiyil vaḻaṅkum. iccollukku nīla ōnāy eṉpatuporuḷ. itu teṉṉāp pirikkāvilum kiḻakkāppirikkāvilum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. pārvaikkuk kaḻutaip pulipōl tōṉṟum. mayiriṉ niṟam paḻuppu. itil aintāṟu kuṟukkup paṭṭaikaḷ irupuṟamum uṇṭu. itaṉ mukkiya uṇavu kaṟai yāṉ, pūcci, puḻu mutaliyaṉa.
paṇṭā: (Panda) imayamalai, tipettu, cīṉā mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kāṇap paṭum oruvakaik karaṭi. kaṟuppum veṇmaiyum kalanta niṟamuḷḷa paṇṭākkaḷ tipettilum cīṉāvilum māttiram kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
paṟakkum aṇil: aṇilil paṟakkumaṇileṉa oruvakai uṇṭu. muṉṉaṅ kālukkum piṉṉaṅkālukkumiṭaiyil uṭaṟpakkamākat tōl vaḷarn tirukkum. itaṉai virittuc caṟukkik koṇṭu ivvaṇil oru maratti liruntu iṉṉoru marattukku ēṟakkuṟaiya 70 yār allatu 80 yār caṟukkikkoṇṭu cellum. it tōlmaṭippu vimāṉakkuṭaipōlap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. ivvaṇil pōrṇiyō mutaliya malāyttīvukaḷilum, ilaṅkaiyilum kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.
pāṭcar: (Badger) karaṭi iṉattaic cērnta ciṟiya vilaṅku. nilattil kuḻi tōṇṭi vāḻvatu.
pāpūṉ: (Baboon) nāymukak kuraṅku eṉappaṭum pāpūṉ āppirikkāvilum arāpiyāvilum kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. itu marattil vāḻum. nilattil nāṉku kālkaḷil naṭantu tiriyum.
pāṟpai vilaṅkukaḷ: (Marsupials) ivai kuṭṭikaḷai īṉṟavuṭaṉ vaittuk kāppāṟṟa aṭivayiṟṟil paiyuṭaiya vilaṅkukaḷ. kuṭṭikaḷ pāṟpaiyu ḷiruntu tāyiṉ pālai uṇṭuvaḷarum. ā°tirēliya vilaṅkuka ḷellām ivvakaiyiṉa.
pirāṇikaḷ tāvaraṅkaḷiṉ viññāṉap peyarkaḷ: ippirippu iṉam (Species) eṉṉum alakiliruntu ārampikkiṉṟaṉa. iṉaṅkaḷ pirivu (Genera) eṉṉum kūṭṭamākap pirikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pirivukaḷ vakai (Class) eṉṉum vakaiyākavum, vakai tokutiyākavum (Phyla), tokuti tāvaraṅkaḷ pirāṇikaḷākavum pirikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pīvar (Beaver): vaṭa amerikkāvil kāṇappaṭum koṟikkum pirāṇi. itu peritum nīril vāḻum. pōtiya nīril vāḻvataṟkāka oru kūṭṭam pīvarkaḷ palliṉāl maraṅkaḷaik kaṭittu viḻutti ammara aṭikaḷaik koṇṭu aṇaikaṭṭi nīraittaṭukkum.
pūcci tiṉṉum pālūṭṭikaḷ: mūñcūṟu, muḷḷeli, maramūñcūṟu mutaliyaṉa.
mārkōppōlō āṭu: pārmīr pīṭapūmiyil 16,000 aṭi uyarattil ovi° pōḷai eṉṉum aḻakiya āṭukaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. mārkkōp pōlō ivaṟṟaippaṟṟik kuṟippiṭṭirukkiṟār. ākavē ivai pōlō āṭukaḷ eṉappaṭum. mutirnta kaṭā āṭukaḷiṉ kompu mikap periyatu; 52 aṅkula nīḷamum aṭiyil 15 aṅkulac cuṟṟaḷavumuḷḷatu. kāliṉ tōḷarukē 44 aṅkula uyaramirukkum. cila āṭukaḷiṉ eṭai 250 irāttal varaiyil uṇṭu.
muḷḷeli: (Hedgehog) pūccikaḷait tiṉṉum ciṟiya vilaṅku. itaṉuṭalil mayirukkup patil ciṟiya muṭkaḷ kiṭakkum. itu irākkālattil veḷiyē vantu nattaikaḷ, paṟavaikkuñcukaḷ, pāmpukaḷ, paḻaṅkaḷ, pūccikaḷai uṇṇum.
yāṉai: nilattil vāḻum vilaṅkukaḷuḷ mikapperiyatu. itil āppirikkā yāṉai, āciya yāṉai eṉa iruvakai uṇṭu. āppirikka yāṉaiyiṉ kātukaḷ mikapperiyavai. āciya yāṉaiyiṉ āṇukkuk kompuṇṭu; peṇṇukku illai. āppirikka yāṉaikaḷiṉ āṇukkum peṇ ṇukkum kompuṇṭu. yāṉaikaḷ tamatu periyavayiṟṟai nirappuvataṟku nāḷil 18 maṇi nēram mēyum. avai tutikkaiyiṉāl uṇavai eṭuttu vāykkuḷ vaittuṇṇum.
varikkutirai: kutiraikkum kaḻutaikkum iṭaippaṭṭa vilaṅku. atu āppirikkāvil māttiram kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu. ataṟkuk kaṟuppu niṟattil veḷḷai varikaḷuṇṭu.
vālillākkuraṅku: maṉitaraippōṉṟa tōṟṟamuṭaiya vilaṅku. kavintu naṭattal, nīṇṭa kaikaḷuṭaiyaṉavātal, uṭalil neruṅki vaḷarnta urōmamiruttal pōṉṟa cila vakaikaḷil itu maṉitaṉiliruntu vēṟupaṭum. ippoḻutu kāṇappaṭum vālillāk kuraṅkukaḷ nāl vakai, kipaṉ, orāṅ ūttāṅ eṉpaṉa kiḻakkāciyāvilum, cimpaṉci, koṟilā eṉpaṉa āppirikkāvilum kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pautikam
aṭaikākkum peṭṭi: (Incubator) paṟavaikaḷ muṭṭai mēliruntu aṭai kāttu veppamaḷippataṟkup patil amaikkappaṭṭa ceyaṟkai muṟai. muṟkālattil kuḻāykaḷ mūlam vennīraic celuttik kāṟṟukku veppamūṭṭappaṭṭatu. ippoḻutu kāṟṟaic cūṭēṟṟi uḷḷē pukut tummuṟai kaiyāḷappaṭukiṟatu. vāyuviḷakkiṉālum eṇṇeyaṭuppi ṉālum vāyuvaic cūṭākkalām. peṭṭikaḷil āyirakkaṇakkāṉa muṭṭaikaḷai iṭṭuk kuñcu porikka vaikkalām.
ākāyakkappal: itu kāṟṟilum pāraṅkuṟaintatu; curuṭṭu vaṭivuṭaiyatu; haiṭirōcil allatu heliyam vāyu nirappi aṭaikkappaṭuvatu. ivvakai ākāyak kappalai mutaliṟceytu paṟakka viṭṭavar ceppa liṉ (Zeppelin) eṉṉum cermāṉiyar. ākavē itu ceppaliṉ eṉap paṭṭatu. itu ippoḻutu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuva tillai.
āḻaṅkāṇal: (Sounding) kayiṟṟil allatu kampiyil īyakkuṇṭaik kaṭṭik kaṭaluḷ viṭṭu āḻaṅkāṇal paḻaiya muṟai. ippoḻutu oliyaik kīḻē celutti atu aṭikkuc ceṉṟu tirumpi varum nērattaik koṇṭu kaṭalāḻattai aḷakkum muṟai kaiyāḷappaṭu kiṟatu. nīril cellum oliyiṉ vēkam viṉāṭikku 1,600 yār ivvāṟu āḻaṅkāṇpataṟku amaikkappaṭṭa entirakkaruvi uṇṭu.
āḻaveṭi: (Depth Charge) kaṭaṟcuraṅka veṭikaḷiloṉṟu. kuṟippiṭṭa ōr āḻattai aṭaintatum nīriṉ aḻuttattāl itaṉ tiri iyaṅki itai veṭikkacceyyum. nīrmūḻki enta āḻattiluḷḷatō ataṟku ēṟpa veṭikkumāṟu itaṉ tiriyai māṟṟiyamaikkalām. āḻaveṭi nīr mūḻkiyai nērākat tākkāviṭṭālum nīrukkuḷ valuvāṉa aḻutta alaikaḷait tōṟṟuvittu nīrḻūḻki pala yār tūrattiliruntālum ataṟkuc cētam viḷaikkum. kappaliṉ mēltaṭṭiliruntu uruṭṭi viṭṭō pīraṅkiyaikkoṇṭu cuṭṭō itaṉaik kaṭalil eṟivārkaḷ.
iṭiktāpōṉ: (Dictaphone) itu oruvar pēcuvatai nīṇṭa uruḷai vaṭivāṉa meḻukil patintu koṇṭu atai maṟupaṭi tiruppi olippa tākiya karuvi. itaṉ amaippu 1877il eṭicaṉ kaṇṭupiṭitta pōṉō kirāp eṉpataip piṉpaṟṟiyatu. itu kaiyaccu aṭikkavēṇṭiya vācakaṅkaḷaic colluvataṟkākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. kaiyaccaṭip pavar olipatiyappaṭṭuḷḷa uruḷaiyiliruntu collappaṭuvataik kēṭṭuk kaiyaccaṭippār.
iṭīcel eñciṉ (Diesel Engine) itu uḷḷeri eñciṉ. itu mōṭṭār vaṇṭikkup payaṉpaṭuttum kalṇeṇṇeyi (Petrol) lum pārkka vilai kuṟainta pāramāṉa eṇṇeyai erittu iyaṅkuvatu. itaṟkum poṟi uṇṭākum aṭaippu (Plug) allatu veṭikkac ceyyum upāyaṅkaḷ illai. eṇṇey mikakkūṭiya aḻuttattilirukkum pōtu atu uruḷaikkuḷ (ciliṇṭarukkuḷ) pukuttappaṭukiṟatu. ivvāṟu uṇṭāṉa aḻuttattiṉāl uṇṭākum cūṭu eṇṇeykku neruppu mūṭṭi veṭikkac ceykiṟatu. ivvāṟu uṇṭākum veṭi pi°ṭaṉait (Piston) taḷḷukiṟatu. ivvakai eñciṉaip pāri° nakaril piṟanta uruṭōlv iṭīcel (Rudolf Diesal) 1895l ceytār. iṉṟu iṭīcel entiraṅkaḷ ulōrikaḷ, (lorry) kappalkaḷ, pukaivaṇṭikaḷil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
irāṭar (Radar) irēṭiyō alaikaḷaik kaṇṇukkut teriyāta tolaiviluḷḷa poruḷmītu celutta avvalaikaḷ apporuḷkaḷ mītu paṭṭu mīḷvatāl apporuḷkaḷaik kāṭṭakkūṭiya karuvi. itu yuttakālattil etiriyiṉ vimāṉaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭupiṭittaṟkum, etiriyiṉ taḷaṅkaḷil kuṇṭu vīcuvataṟkum utaviyākaviruntatu. itu ippoḻutu vimāṉaṅkaḷilum kappalkaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. vāṉa ārāycciyāḷar itaṉutaviyāl pala putiya ceytikaḷai aṟintuḷḷaṉar. (Ra - radio; D - detection; A - and ; R - ranging)
irumpu nuraiyīral: (Iron Lung) toṇṭaik karappaṉ, iḷampiḷḷai vātam pōṉṟa cila nōykaḷil mūccut tacaikaḷ tamatu caktiyai iḻantu viṭukiṉṟaṉa. ataṉāl mārpiṉ iyakkam niṉṟupōy nōyāḷi iṟakka nērum. appoḻutu ceyaṟkai muṟaiyāka mūccuviṭac ceyyum cāta ṉaṅkaḷil ituvumoṉṟu. itaṉai iṭiriṅkar (Drinker) eṉṉum maruttuvar 1928il kaṇṭupiṭittār.
ilaiṉō accu: (Linotype) itu accukkaḷai vari, variyākak kōkkum entiram. itil cātāraṇa kaiyaccup peṭṭiyil (Typewriter) iruppatu pōla eḻuttukkaḷ kuṟikkappaṭṭa pottāṉkaḷ koṇṭa varicaikaḷ irukkum. ētāvatu oru pottāḷai aḻuttiṉāl atu cila kampi kaḷai iyakki acceḻuttuk koṇṭa peṭṭiyiliruntu appot tāṉukkuḷḷa eḻuttai veḷiyē eṭuttu oru kālvāy vaḻiyē ōr iṭattukkuk koṇṭu pōkum. pottāṉai aḻuttikkoṇṭu vantāl eḻuttukkaḷ varicaiyil avviṭattai aṭaiyum. ivvāṟu eḻuttukkaḷ cērntavuṭaṉ vārppuppeṭṭi eṉpataṟku eṭuttuc cellappaṭum. aṅku urukiya accu īyam irukkum. vārkka vēṇṭiya vari itaṉai aṭaintatum urukiya īyam oru kuḻāyiṉ vaḻiyāka eḻuttukkaḷiṉ mēl pāyntu oru vari accait tōṟṟuvikkum. ivvāṟu varivariyāka accai vārppatiṉāl itaṟku “ilaiṉō ṭaip” eṉṉum peyaruṇṭāyiṟṟu. itu aintu tiṟamaiyuḷḷa toḻilāḷar ceyyum vēlaiyaic ceyyavallatu.
īruruḷi: (Bicycle) itu pāṉṭirēyil (Baron Drail) eṉṉum cermaṉiyarāl 1818il mutaṉ mutal ceyyappaṭṭatu. mutaṉ mutaṟceyyappaṭṭa īru ruḷiyai oṭṭupavar orumuṟai oru kālālum maṟṟamuṟai maṟṟak kālālum nilattilutaintu atai uruṭṭikkoṇṭu ceṉṟār. itaṉ piṉ maraccakkaraṅkaḷum irumpu vaḷaiyamum uḷḷa elumpu uluppi (bobe shaker) eṉṉum vaṇṭi ceyyappaṭṭatu. itaṉpiṉ periya muṉ cakkaramum ciṟiya piṉ cakkaramuḷḷa peṉṉi pārtiṅ (Penny farthing) eṉṉum vaṇṭi ceyyappaṭṭatu. ikkāla muṟaiyāṉa īruruḷi 1885il ceyyappaṭṭatu.
urupperukku oḷippaṭam: (Microphotography) itu aṇupperukki āṭi mūlam ciṟiya paṭaṅkaḷaip periyaṉavākap paṭam piṭikkummuṟai. itu ciṉimāppaṭam piṭikkum muṟaiyil mikap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. 1880 mutal itu viññāṉikaḷāl kaiyāḷappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
uḷḷeri eñciṉ (internal Combustion engine): eri poruḷiṉ iracāyaṉa cakti entirattiṉuḷḷē erintu veṭittu veḷiyāvatāl iyaṅkum entiram. ic caktiyiṉāl virivaṭaiyum vāyu entirattai uruḷac ceykiṟatu. iv vakaiyil iyaṅkum entiraṅkaḷil mutaṉmaiyāṉavai peṭrōl, iṭīcel entiraṅkaḷākum. mutal peṭrōl entirattai amaittavar oṭṭō (N.A.Otto) eṉṉum poṟivallārāvar. kāḷ peṉ°, iṭayam piḷar (Karl Benz and Daimler)eṉpōr mutal mōṭṭār vaṇṭiyai 1885il ceytaṉar.
urokkeṭ: (Rocket) itaṟku ākāca vāṇam eṉpatu poruḷ. cīṉar itaṉai ki.pi.1200kku muṉ aṟintiruntaṉar. itu vēṭikkaikku māttira mallāmal kappal, vimāṉaṅkaḷukku caikai (ciknal) kāṭṭavum, kappal kaḷukku vaṭakkayiṟṟaik koṇṭupōkavum vēṟu palavakaikaḷilum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. ippoḻutu pōriṟ payaṉpaṭuttum ēvu paṭaik kalaṅkaḷ (guided missiles) urokkeṭ eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivaṟṟuḷ tiṇmaiyāṉa eriporuḷkaḷukkup patil tiravap pirāṇavāyu pōṉṟa vāyukkaḷ aṭittuc celuttap paṭṭirukkum. ivaṟṟiṉ celavai irēṭiyō alaikaḷāl kaṭṭuppaṭuttalām. cermaṉiyar payaṉpaṭuttiya paṟakkum kuṇṭu (v.2) ivvakaiyiṉatu.
ek°-katirkaḷ: itu uroṉṭceṉ (Roentgen) eṉpavarāl 1895-l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭa oḷikkatir. itu oḷipukāp poruḷkaḷai uruvip pāyak kūṭiyatu. itaṉ taṉmaikaḷ naṉṟāka aṟiyappaṭāmaliruntamai yiṉ itaṟku ek° katir (X-rays) eṉap peyarippaṭṭatu. uṭaṟ kōḷāṟukaḷ muṟivu taṟivukaḷaip oḷippaṭam piṭittup pārppataṟku maruttuvattuṟaiyil itu peritum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
entirak kalappai: kalleṇṇeyāl ōṭṭappaṭum entirakkalappaiyai pēkkar (Burgher) eṉṉum amerikkar 1889-l ceytār. heṉṟipōṭ kuṟainta vilaiyil kiṭaikkakkūṭiya entirak kalappaikaḷai viyāpāra muṟaiyil ceytār.
entirattaṟi (Fly Shuttle) yōṉ kē (John kay) yāl 1733-l kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭṭatu. itu ūṭunūlai kaiyāleṟintu vāṅkuvataṟkup patil nempukōlāl ceyyakkūṭiya amaippu. itaṉāl cātāraṇa necavil necavākakkūṭiya tuṇiyilum pārkka itil irumaṭi tuṇi neyyak kūṭiyatāka viruntatu.
elikōptar (Helicopter) kāṟṟilum pārkkap pāraṅkūṭiya paṟakkum entiram. itaṟku iṟakkaikaḷ illai; mūṉṟu alakukaḷālāṉa cuḻaluṅkāṟṟāṭi mēlē uṇṭu. mutaṉ mutal (1923il) ivvakai vimāṉattil paṟantavar pireñcup poṟivallārākiya urōlṭi pā°karā (Raoul de Pascara) itaṉāl nērkuttāka iṟaṅkavum eḻumpavum muṭiyum. itaṉ vāṟpuṟat tilum mūṉṟu alakukaḷālāṉa ciṟiya cuḻalum kāṟṟāṭiyuṇṭu. vimāṉa nilaiyaṅkaḷillāta iṭaṅkaḷilum itaṉāl iṟaṅkavum eḻumpavum muṭiyum.
eṟikuṇṭu (Grenade): 25 yār tūram varaiyil eṟiyappaṭum eṟikuṇṭu. kuṇṭu veṭikkumiṭattiliruntu 30 aṭi tūrattiluḷḷa poruḷkaḷel lām apāyattukkuḷḷākum. itu kaikalappup pōril etirikaḷ mītu eṟiyappaṭuvatu.
ēriyal: (Aerial) vāṉolikkaruviyiṉ pakuti; cūḻntuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷukku miṉ caktiyaip parappuvatu. itu kāppu iṭappaṭṭa (Insutaled)kampi allatu kampiccuruḷākavirukkum.
oṭṭō kairō (Autogyro) kāṟṟilum pāramāṉa paṟakkum entiram. itu elikkōptar (Helicopter) vimāṉattaippōla nērkuttāka eḻumpa vum iṟaṅkavum kūṭiyatu. itaṉ iṟakkaikaḷ uṟutiyāka iruppataṟkup patil cuḻalukkūṭiyavai. itu iṟaṅkuvataṟku atika iṭam vēṇṭiya tillai. itu vīṭṭuk kūraikaḷilum iṟaṅkakkūṭum. itaṉai mutaliṟ ceytavar Jaun de la cierva eṉṉum i°pāṉiyar (1924)
oliparapputal: (Broadcasting) vāṉoli nilaiyattiluḷḷa karuvi mūlam ceytikaḷaiyum icaikaḷaiyum parapputal. ivvāṟu oli perukkak kūṭum ceytikaḷai vāṅki veḷiviṭakkūṭiya karuvi irēṭiyōp peṭṭi (Receiving set) eṉappaṭukiṟatu.
oliperukki: (Loud Speaker) itu oliyai miṉcāra caktiyāka māṟṟi atait tirumpa atē oliyāka urakkakkēṭkumpaṭi māṟṟakkūṭiya karuvi.
olippativuḷḷa ciṉimāppaṭam: (Sound film): ciṉimāppaṭak kāṭci toṭaṅkiya kālam mutal paṭaṅkaḷukku oliyai iṇaippataṟku vēṇṭiya muyaṟ cikaḷ ceyyappaṭṭu vantaṉa. toṭakkattil oliyillāta pilmkaḷukku kirāmapōṉ taṭṭukaḷ mūlam oli utavappaṭṭatu. pilmiṉ oru orattil oli patiyappaṭukiṟatu. paṭam tiraiyil kāṭṭappaṭum pōtu oli mīṭpu oliyāka veḷippaṭukiṟatu. itu tiraikkup piṉpuṟattiliruntu varumāṟu oliperukki mūlam veḷiyiṭappaṭukiṟatu.
urupperukkum āṭi (Magnifying glass): itu oru kuvileṉ°. itaṉūṭāka oru poruḷaip pārttāl apporuḷ peritākat terikiṟatu. itaṉaic cīṉarum piṟarum muṟkālattil aṟintiruntaṉar.
kaṭal tantikkampi iṇaippu: (Cable-laying) mutal tanti kalē° (Calais) uṭōvar (Dover) eṉṉum iru iṭaṅkaḷukkumiṭaiyil 1850il pōṭappaṭṭatu. iṉṟu ēṟakkuṟaiya 4,50,000 kaṭalmail tūrattukkuk kaṇṭaṅkaḷai iṇaittukoṇṭirukkum kaṭal tantikkampikaḷ pōṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
kaṭalvimāṉam: (Sea Plane) tarai vimāṉaṅkaḷukkuk kīḻē cakkaraṅkaḷ poruttappaṭṭirukkum. kaṭal vimāṉaṅkaḷukkuc cakkaraṅkaḷukkup patil mitavaikaḷ irukkum. ivaṟṟukkuk kaṭaliliṟaṅkavum kaṭali liruntu mēlē paṟakkavum muṭiyum.
kaṭikāram: kālamaḷakkuṅ karuvi. itaṉ iyaṅku cakti paḷu, vil (Spring) allatu miṉcārattiṉāl utavappaṭalām. muṟkālattil vaḻaṅkiya maṇaṟ kaṭikārattil maṇaliṉ paḷuvē iyaṅku caktiyāka viruntatu. paḷuvaik koṇṭu iyaṅkum kaṭikāram 2ām cilve°tarāl (Pope Silverster II) ceyyappaṭṭateṉa (ki.pi. 1,000) nampappaṭukiṟatu. ik kāla vakaiyāṉa ciṟukaṭikāram cermaṉiyil nūrempek eṉṉum iṭattil vāḻnta oruvarāl 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭatu.
kēmirā: (Camera) oru pakkattil ciṟu tuvāramuḷḷa peṭṭi. tuvārattiṉ vaḻiyē veḷiccam ceṉṟu kāṭciyiṉ niḻalaip peṭṭiyiṉ aṭutta cuvaril talaikīḻāka viḻacceyyum. iv vakaik kamirāvai ili ṉārṭō ṭāviṉci (Leonardo da vinci) eṉṉum ittāliyar 1,500-l kaṇṭupiṭittār. itiliruntu iṉṟu paṭampiṭikkum vakaiyāṉa kamirā vaḷarcciyaṭaintatu.
kalvaṉik miṉkala aṭukku: (Galvanic Battery) itu vōlṭā (Volta) eṉṉum ittāliyarāl 1800il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. iraṇṭu vakai ulō kaṅkaḷ amilattōṭu campantappaṭumpōtu miṉṉēṟṟa muṇṭākiṟa teṉṉum aṭippaṭaiyaik koṇṭu itu tayārikkappaṭukiṟatu. ovvoru miṉkalattilum kantaka amilattil naṉainta tuṇiyiṉāl maṟaikkappaṭṭa nāka, cemput takaṭukaḷ vaikkappaṭum, ivvakai miṉkala aṭukkukaḷ pala oṉṟāka iṇaikkappaṭum. ikkāla akkumi lēṭṭarkaḷukku muṉ vaḻaṅkiyavai ivvakai miṉkala aṭukkukaḷē.
kaṟparappiya vīti: pāpilōṉiyarum intiyarum ki.mu. 2,000 varaiyil kaṟparappiya vītikaḷai amaittaṉar. kirēkkarum avvakai vītikaḷai amaittaṉar. urōmar irāṇuvat tēvaikaḷukkāka vītikaḷamaikkum muṟaiyait tiṭṭappaṭuttiṉar. piriṭṭaṉil urōmar amaitta vītikaḷ 16aṭi akalamuḷḷaṉa. ikkāla muṟaiyāṉa vītiyamaippu 1,800-l toṭaṅkiyatu.
kāṟṟukkoḷḷum cakkara vaḷaiyaṅkaḷ: īruruḷi (paicikkiḷ) mōṭṭār vaṇṭi vimāṉaṅkaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttum kāṟṟukkoḷḷum vaḷai yaṅkaḷ iṭaṉlop (Boyd Dunlop) eṉṉum i°kottiyarāl 1888il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
kuḷir kāppuppeṭṭi: (Refrigerator) taṉatu uḷveḷiyiluḷḷa vāyuvaik kuḷiracceytu veppattai akaṟṟakkūṭiya entiram. itu uṇavup poruḷkaḷaik keṭāmalum kuḷirākavum vaittiruppataṟkup peritum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
caṟukku vimāṉam: (Glider) itu entiramillāta vimāṉam. kāṟṟāṭip paṭṭattaip pōla mēlē paṟakkumpaṭi itaṉai iḻuttuppiṭikkum kayiṟṟai veṭṭi viṭṭāl itu kāṟṟiṟ paṟantu cellum.ivvakaic caṟukki vimāṉattai mutaṉ mutal celuttiyavar oṭṭō lilintal (Otto Lilienthal). ivar 1896il caṟukku vimāṉattōṭu viḻuntu maraṇa māṉār. caṟukku vimāṉam 6 maṇi nērattil 195 mail paṟantirukkiṟatu.
ciṉimāppaṭakkāṭci: (Cinematograph) oru toṭarpāṉa paṭaṅkaḷai cellu lōyiṭ pilmil viraivākap piṭittu avaṟṟait tiraiyil viḻumpaṭi yākak kāṭṭuvatu. taṉittaṉippaṭaṅkaḷ viraivāka oṭik koṇṭiruppa tāl paṭaṅkaḷ uṇmaiyil naṭamāṭuvatupōlat tōṉ ṟum. oru tōṟṟam kaṇṇil paṭṭu maṟainta piṉpum viṉāṭiyil oru pakuti nēram kaṇṇukkup pulaṉākik koṇṭirukkumātaliṉ vēkamāka ōṭum paṭaṅkaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu cērntiruppatākat tōṉṟum. 1926il ippaṭaṅkaḷukku oliyaiyum cērttup payaṉpaṭuttum muṟai aṟiyap paṭṭatu. 1890il cellulōyiṭ pilm kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ciṉimā paṭam piṭikkum kamirāvai ulūmayari (Lumiere) eṉṉum pirāṉciyarum avar cakōtararum 1895il ceytārkaḷ.
cēvṭi lāmp: (Safety Lamp) iṭēvi (Humphry Davy) eṉpavarāl 1815l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. itu curaṅkaṅkaḷil vēṟu vakai viḷakkukakaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl tīppiṭittu apāya muṇṭāvatait taṭuppataṟkākac ceyyappaṭṭatu. itu iṉṟum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
taṭṭaccu: (Typewriter) ilitām cōl° (Lithamsholes) eṉpavar mutal taṭṭaccai 1868-l ceytār. itu iremiṅṭaṉ kampaṉiyārāl viyāpāramuṟaiyil ceyyappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.
tanti: puḷḷi, kīṟu eṉṉum aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷaikkoṇṭu miṉcārak karuvimūlam koṭukkappaṭum ceyti muṟai. itaṉ “kōṭṭu” mōr° eṉṉum amerikkarāl oḻuṅkupaṭuttappaṭṭatu. iṉṟu tanti perum pālum teli piriṇṭēr° (Teleprinters) mūlam naṭaipeṟukiṟatu.
tāṅkikaḷ: (Tanks) muṟkāla naiṭṭukaḷ (Knights) tamatu uṭalaip palavakai ulōkak kavacaṅkaḷāl maṟaintārkaḷ. tāṅkikaḷ eṉpaṉa kavacantāṅkiya mōṭṭahr vaṇṭikaḷ. tāṅkikaḷukkuc cakkaraṅkaḷukkup patil kampaḷip puḻuviṉ kālpōṉṟa caṅkili amaippu uṇṭu. avai paḷḷam mēṭu uḷḷa vaḻikaḷāl cellakkūṭiyavai. naiṭṭukaḷiṉ kavacaṅkaḷiṉ vaḷarcciyē tāṅkiyākum.
ticaikāṭṭi: (Compass) ticai kāṭṭuṅkaruvi. kāntamēṟṟappaṭṭa ūciyait taṭaiyiṉṟic cuḻalumpaṭi naṭuvil camaṉceytu vaittāl atiṉ oru muṉai kānta turuvattai (vaṭakkai) nōkkum. mārk kōppōlō cīṉāviliruntu tirumpiyapiṉ ticaiyaṟi karuviyaippaṟṟi airōp piyarukkut terivittāṉ. ūci nēr vaṭakkaik kāṭṭātu.kānta turuvattaik kāṭṭukiṉṟateṉpatu kolampacāl aṟiyappaṭṭiruntatu.
tirāmvē: (Tramway) pukaivaṇṭit toṭaraip pōlat taṇṭapāḷattil cellum pōkkuvarattuc cātaṉam. itu viraivil maṟaintu varukiṉ ṟatu. kutiraikaḷāl iḻukkappaṭum tirām vaṇṭic cēvai niyūyōkkil toṭaṅkiṟṟu. 1881il miṉcārattiṉāl celuttappaṭum tirām cēvai cērmaṉiyil toṭaṅkiyatu. kutiraikaḷāliḻukkappaṭum tirāmvē ilaṇṭaṉil 1905varai iruntatu. tirāmvēyiṉ iṭattai ippoḻutu turolli pa°kaḷ (Trolley Bus) eṭuttu varukiṉṟaṉa.
telipōṉ: miṉcārak kampimūlam olikaḷaic celuttuvataṟkuḷḷa karuvi. itu oliyai miṉcāra alaiyāka māṟṟi maṟṟap pakkattil maṟupaṭiyum oli alaikaḷāka veḷiyiṭukiṟatu. alakcāntar kirakāmpel eṉpavar itaṉai 1876il kaṇṭupiṭittār.
taiyal entiram: itu eliya° hō (Elias Howe) eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1845-l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ataṉaip piṉpaṟṟic ciṅkar (I.M.Singer) taiyal entiraṅkaḷaic ceytār. ippoḻutu vaḻaṅkum taiyal entiraṅkaḷ ivventira amaippaip piṉpaṟṟic ceyyappaṭuvaṉa.
tolaikkāṭci: (Television) niḻal vaṭivattai irēṭiyō alaikaḷ mūlam celuttutal. tolaikkāṭci mutaṉmutal yōṉpayāṭ eṉpavarāl 1926il kāṭṭappaṭṭatu. mutal tolaikāṭci nilaiyam ilaṇṭaṉi luḷḷa alekcāṇṭar palē° eṉṉumiṭattil 1936il ārampikkap paṭṭatu. vāṉolip peṭṭiyil nām oliyai māttiram kēṭkiṟōm. tolaik kāṭcip peṭṭiyil oliyaik kēṭpatōṭu uruvaṅkaḷai yum kāṇkiṉṟōm.
tolainōkki: (Telescope) tolaiviluḷḷa poruḷkaḷaik kiṭṭa iruppatākak kāṭṭum āṭi. itu mutaṉ mutal urocar pēkaṉ (Roger Bacon) eṉpavarāl 13ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭatu. kaliliyō 1609il ceyta tolainōkkiyiṉ amaippaip piṉpaṟṟi ikkālat tolai nōkkikaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
nilai miṉkāṭṭi: (Electroscope) miṉṉēṟṟam iruppatai aṟivikkum karuvi. itu kāveṇṭiṣ (Hentry Carvendish) eṉṉum āṅkila viññāṉiyāl 1790-l kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
nīrmūḻki: nīrukkuk kīḻāl cellakkūṭiya amaippil ceyyappaṭṭa kappal. ik kāla muṟaiyāṉa nīr mūḻki holaṇṭ eṉṉum ayarlāntu vāciyāl amerikkāvil 1875-l kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. nīrmūḻki nīril mūḻkiyirukkum pōtu uḷḷē iruppavar peri°kōp (Periscope) eṉṉum karuvi mūlam nīr maṭṭattiluḷḷavaṟṟaip pārkkalām.
nīrmūḻku kūṭu: (Bathyspher) itu kaṭalāḻattiṟkuc ceṉṟu aṅkuḷḷa uyir vakaikaḷai oḷippaṭam piṭittu ārāycci ceyvataṟkāka villiyam pīpi (Dr.William Beebe)eṉṉum amerikkar payaṉpaṭuttiya uruṇṭai vaṭivāṉa urukku aṟai.
nīrvīḻcci miṉcāra nilaiyam: (Hydro-Electric Power Station) itu muṟkāla nīr ālai (Wind Mill)yiṉ tiruntiya amaippu; aṇaikkaṭṭu nīrt tēkkaṅkaḷ amaittu avaṟṟiṉ nīrvīḻcciyiṉālum,āṟṟunīr vīḻcci yiṉālum cakkaraṅkaḷai iyaṅkac ceytu miṉcāra caktiyai uṟpatti yākkum cakkara amaippuḷḷa iyantira nilaiyam. itaṉaik kaṇṭupiṭit tavar pōrṉiraṉ (Beniot Fourneyron) eṉṉum pirāṉciyar (1827).
paṭattanti: paṭaṅkaḷait tantimūlam allatu irēṭiyō mūlam aṉuppu tal. itaṉai kaṇṭupiṭittavar ātar kōṇ (Arthur Korn) eṉṉum cermaṉ viññāṉi (1904)
paracūṭ: kuṭaivaṭivāṉa tuṇi; vimāṉattiliruntu kutippavarkaḷ payaṉ paṭuttuvatu. kutikkiṉṟavariṉ pārattiṉāl paracūṭ virintu kāṟṟiṉ taṭuppai atikappaṭuttukiṟatu. oru maṉitaṉaik kīḻē koṇṭuvarum paracūṭ 24 aṭi viṭṭamuḷḷatākavirukka vēṇṭum.
pai piḷēṉ: (Biplane) oru iṟakkaikku mēl iṉṉoru iṟakkaiyuḷḷa vimāṉam.
miṉcāram ākki: (Electric Generator) entira caktiyai miṉcāra caktiyāka māṟṟuṅ karuvi. itu iṭaiṉamō eṉavum peyar peṟum itaṉai mutaliṟ ceytavar kirām (Gramme)eṉṉum pirāṉciya poṟivallār (1873). oru kāntattiṉ turuvaṅkaḷiṭaiyē uḷḷa parappil oru curuḷ kampi vēkamākac cuḻalvatāl miṉcāram uṇṭākiṟateṉṉum pāraṭē (Faraday) kaṇṭupiṭitta uṇmaiyai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu itu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. itaṉ entira cakti uyarattiliruntu viḻum nīr allatu nīrāvi, allatu eṇṇey entiraṅkaḷāl utavappaṭalām.
miṉkāntam: (Electromagent) oru irumpaic cuṟṟi kāppiṭappaṭṭa kampiyaic cuṟṟik kampikku miṉ ēṟṟiṉāl irumpu kānta caktiyaṭaikiṟatu. miṉ ṉōṭṭam niṉṟavuṭaṉ irumpu kāntat taṉmaiyai iḻantu viṭu kiṉṟatu. miṉkānta muṟaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭittavar āṅkila viññāṉi yākiya i°rūrciyaṉ (Sturgeon) āvar (1820).
miṉcāramaṇi: (Electric Bell) yōcep heṉṟi eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1840il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. irumput tuṇṭoṉṟaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa kampiyil miṉcāram ōṭumpōtu irumpu kāntattaṉmai aṭaikiṉṟa teṉṉum uṇmaiyai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu itu kaṇṭupiṭik kappaṭṭatu. oru pottāṉai aḻuttumpōtu miṉcārattiṉ cuṟṟōṭ ṭam oru muṟai muṭivaṭaikiṟatu. irumpu kāntattaṉmaiyaṭaintu maṇiyaittaṭṭum cuttiyal pōṉṟa pakutiyuṭaiya iṉṉoru irumpai iḻukkiṟatu. cuttiyal maṇiyait taṭṭukiṟatu. avvāṟu aṭikkumpōtu atu oru caṅkuppuri āṇikku veḷiyē vantu miṉcāra ōṭṭattai veṭṭukiṟatu. ākavē maṟupaṭiyum atu paḻaiya nilaikku varukiṟatu. piṉ kāntattāl iḻukkappaṭṭu maṇiyil taṭṭukiṟatu. ivvāṟu noṭi yil palamuṟai naṭaipeṟum. miṉcārattiṉ cuṟṟōṭṭattukku pāṭṭari kaḷai allatu miṉcāra nilaiyattiliruntu varum miṉcārattaip payaṉpaṭuttalām.
miṉcāra viḷakku: miṉ caktiyaip palavakaikaḷil veḷiccamāka māṟṟalām. (1) vilviḷakku muṟai. hampiriṭēvi (Humpry Davy) iraṇṭu kārpaṉ kaḷil pāyum miṉcāram pirapaiyāṉa veḷiccattai uṇṭākkukiṟateṉa 1870il kaṇṭupiṭittār. ivvakai veḷiccaṅkaḷ ippoḻutu ciṉimāppaṭa niḻal vīḻtti(Projectors)kaḷilum turuvu viḷakku(Search light)kaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. (2) miṉcāra palp viḷakku pātaraca āvi nirappappaṭṭa kuḻal viḷakku mutaliyaṉa vēṟu vakai miṉcāra viḷakkukaḷākum.
miṉ mulām pūcutal: (Electroplating) miṉcārattiṉ utaviyāl oru ulōkattukku mēl iṉṉoru ulōkak karaivaip pūcutal ippeyar peṟum. ivvāṟu ceyyum muṟai iṭēvi (Davy)eṉpavarāl kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. irumpup poruḷkaḷukku melliya veḷḷip paṭalam allatu vēṟu ulōkap paṭalam pūcalām. miṉ ōṭṭam ulōkak karaicalkaḷaic ciṟu tukaḷkaḷākak koṇṭu ceṉṟu maṭṭamāka oṭṭavaikkiṉṟatu.
maikrō pilmpaṭikaḷ: (Microfilm Reproduction) ippoḻutu ariya nūlkaḷ, cācaṉaṅkaḷ, kaṭitaṅkaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟai allatu puttakaṅkaḷ muḻumaiyilumuḷḷa pakkaṅkaḷai 35 milli mīṭṭar pilmkaḷāka paṭam piṭittu paṭam kāṭṭum karuviyāl tiraiyil viḻac ceytu kāṭṭap paṭukiṉṟaṉa. (milli mīṭṭar 0.40 aṅkulam.)
moṉōṭaip entiram: (monotype) moṉōṭaip muṟaiyil accu kaḷaik kōppatum eḻuttukkaḷai vārppatum oru entirattil cey yappaṭuvatillai. inta entirattil eḻuttukkaḷ kuṟitta pottāṉai aḻutta nīṇṭa kākitac curuḷil ovvoru eḻuttukkum cariyāka oru tuvāram ēṟpaṭum. ivvāṟu tuvāraṅkaḷ koṇṭa curuḷai vārpaṭa entirattil māṭṭiviṭṭāl tuvāraṅkaḷukkēṟṟa eḻuttukkaḷait taṉittaṉiyē vārttu vari variyākat takkapaṭi cērttuk koṇṭu varum.
moṉō piḷēṉ: (Monoplane) oru cōṭi (pakkattukkovvoru) iṟakkaiyuṭaiya vimāṉam.
mōṭṭār vaṇṭi: peṭrōl entirattiṉāl ōṭṭappaṭum mōṭṭār vaṇṭi cīk piraiṭ mākku° (Siegfried Marcus) eṉṉum vīyaṉṉāvāci yāl 1875il ōṭṭappaṭṭatu; 10 āṇṭukaḷ kaḻittu kotliyap taimiḷar (Gottlib Daimler) eṉṉum poṟivallār mutal mōṭṭār caikkiḷaic ceytār.
mōr° kōṭ: (Morse Code) mōr° eṉṉum amerikkarāl 1838il tanti pēcuvataṟku vakukkappaṭṭa kuṟṟum, kīṟu maṭaṅkiya kuṟiyīṭukaḷ.
makira°kōp: (Microscope) aṇuperukki (pūtakkaṇṇāṭi) eṉṉum itu ciṟiya poruḷkaḷai 2,000 maṭaṅku peruppittuk kāṭṭak kūṭiya karuvi. itaṉai hāṉ°, yāṉ ceṉ (Hans and Janssen) eṉṉum iraṇṭu ollāntu vācikaḷ 1590-l kaṇṭupiṭittārkaḷ.
yeṭ eñciṉ: (Jet Engine) ākāca vāṉam mēlē eḻumputal, tuppākki veṭikkumpōtu piṉpuṟam taḷḷutal eṉṉum koḷkaiyai aṭip paṭaiyākak koṇṭu amaikkappaṭṭa vimāṉa entiram. viṭṭiḷ (Sir Frank Whittle) eṉpavarāl 1930il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. 1941mutal ivvakai entira amaippuḷḷa vimāṉaṅkaḷ vaḻaṅkukiṉṟaṉa. iv ventiram muṉ pakutiyiṉāl kāṟṟai uṟiñci nerukki eriporuḷ kaḷōṭu kalantu erintu uṇṭākum virinta vāyuvaip piṉpuṟattiṉuḷḷa kūmpiya kuḻāy vaḻiyākat taḷḷukiṟatu. ākācavāṇam vāyuvaik kīḻē taḷḷa atu eppaṭi mēlē eḻumpukiṟatō atē pōl ituvum vimāṉattai mēlē taḷḷukiṟatu.
vākkam kiḷīṉar: (Vacuum cleaner) itu vīṭṭuttarai, taḷapāṭaṅkaḷ, kampaḷam mutaliyavaṟṟaip kāṟṟōṭu tūciyai iḻuttuc cuttañ ceyyum entiram. itu kāṟṟai iḻukkum kuḻāy miṉcārattiṉāl vēlai ceykiṟatu. itu cicil pūt (Cecil Booth) eṉṉum āṅkilarāl 1901il kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
vākkam puṭṭi: itu uṇavukaḷ tiravap poruḷkaḷai vaippataṟkuḷḷa puṭṭi; kuḷirai allatu veppattai atikam iḻukkātapaṭi kāppāṟṟu vatu. itaṉ pakkaṅkaḷ iṭaiyē veḷiyuḷḷa iraṇṭu kaṇṇāṭic cuvarkaḷālāṉavai. iṭaiyēyuḷḷa veḷik kāṟṟakaṟṟappaṭṭu veṟṟiṭa mākavirukkum. itaṉai cēr yēm° tivār (Sir James Dewar) eṉṉum i°kottiya viññāṉi 1896il kaṇṭupiṭittār.
vāyuviḷakku: (Gaslight) nilakkari vāyuvai viḷakkiṉāl erikkum muṟaiyaik kaṇṭupiṭittavar villiyam mārṭok (William Mardock). ivar itaṉai 1792il taṉatu vīṭṭil payaṉpaṭuttiṉār. pattu āṇṭukaḷiṉ piṉ itu ilaṇṭaṉ vītikaḷil viḷakkukaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭatu. 19ām nūṟṟāṇṭil ituvē ceyaṟkai veḷiccamākap payaṉpaṭṭatu. 1855il puṉceṉ (Bunsen) eṉṉum cērmaṉ viññāṉi viḷakkuk kāyai (Burner) kaṇṭupiṭittār. itiyiruntu veḷoḷi koṭukkum valait tuṇittiri (Mantle) kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.
vimāṉam: (Aeroplane) kāṟṟilum pāraṅkūṭiya paṟakkum cātaṉam; uḷ eri entiram allatu ‘yeṭ’entirattiṉāliyaṅkuvatu. ivvakai vimā ṉattai mutalil paṟakkac ceytavarkaḷ, or villi (Orville), vilpar iraiṭ (Wilbur Wright) eṉṉum iru amerikka cakōtararkaḷ. 1903il itaṉaip paṟakkaviṭṭapōtu itu 12 viṉāṭikaḷ paṟantatu. ippoḻutu cila vimāṉaṅkaḷ oli cellum vēkattil (maṇikku 760 mail) paṟak kiṉṟaṉa. 100 pēraik koṇṭu cellakkūṭiya irāṇuva vimāṉaṅkaḷum pirayāṇi vimāṉaṅkaḷumuḷḷaṉa.
veppamāṉi: veppattai aḷakkum karuvi. veppamāṉi aḷavil pāraṉ hēyiṭ, ceṉṭikirēṭ eṉṉum iruvakai aḷavaikaḷ vaḻaṅkum. pāraṉ hēyiṭ aḷavaiyil paṉikkaṭṭi urukum nilai 320. taṇṇīr kotikkum nilai 2120. ceṇṭikirēṭṭil uṟaiyum nilai 00 koti nilai 1000.
ulōkam
accu ulōkam: (Type metal) aṇṭimaṇiyōṭu kārīyamum veḷḷīyamum kalanta ulōkam (kārīyam 60%, aṇṭimaṉi, 30%,veḷḷīyam 10%).
aṇṭimaṉi: (Antimony) oru vakai nīla veḷḷai ulōkam. nīrilum pārkka 6.7 maṭaṅku pāramāṉatu. kuḷirumpōtu curuṅkuvataṟkup patil viriyum taṉmaiyuḷḷatu. itu accu eḻuttu vārkkum ulōkattuṭaṉ kalappa taṟkum vēṟu vārppu ulōkak kalavaikaḷōṭu kalappataṟkum payaṉ paṭukiṟatu.
alumiṉiyam: veṇmaiyāṉa turu vēṟāta ilēcāṉa ulōkam. itaṉ pāram irumpiṉ pārattil 1/3 paṅkākum. itu perumpālum camaiyaṟ pāttiraṅkaḷ ceyyavum vārppup poruḷkaḷ cey yavum payaṉpaṭu kiṟatu. itu vēṟu ulōkaṅkaḷōṭu kalantu vimāṉa uṟuppukkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu. ayarlāntu, pirāṉcu, vaṭa āppirikkā, kiḻak kintiyat tīvukaḷ, kaṉaṭā, uruciyā, intiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷiṟ kiṭaik kiṉṟatu.
iracak kalavai: (Amalgum) pātaracattōṭu vēṟoru ulōkañ cērnta kalavai. veḷḷi, taṅka maṇṇil avvulōkaṅkaḷ iracattaik koṇṭu piritteṭukkappaṭum. iracam ivvulōkat tūḷkaḷōṭu cērntu iracak kalavaiyāka māṟukiṟatu. itaṉaic cūṭākkumpōtu iracam āviyāka māṟip pōyviṭa ulōkat tūḷkaḷ taṅkukiṉṟaṉa.
irumpu: maṉitaṉukku vēṇṭiya ulōkap poruḷkaḷil mika mukkiya māṉatu. itil vārp pirumpu, tēṉirumpu, eḵku eṉa mūṉṟu pirivuka ḷuṇṭu. vārppirumpil 4% kārpaṉ uḷḷatu. itu kaṭiṉamāṉataṉṟu, eḷitil uṭaiyak kūṭiyatu.kaṉi irumpil kārpaṉ kuṟaivāka virukkum. itu kāyccit taṭṭa ēṟṟatu. eḵku allatu urukku eṉpatu irumpum kārpaṉuṅkoṇṭa kalavai. itil kari 1.7% aḷavilirukkum. itu mikak kaṭiṉamāṉatu; kārpaṉē itaṟkuk kāraṇam.
iṉvar: (Invart) nikkalum urukkum kalanta kalavai. itaṉ veppap perukkam mikak kuṟaivāka viruppatāl itu peṇṭulaṅkaḷilum, kaṭikāraṅ kaḷilum aḷavu karuvikaḷilum payaṉākiṟatu. cārla° killōm (Charles Giallaume) itaṉaik kaṇṭupiṭittār.
kalappu ulōkaṅkaḷ: (Alloy) vayiramēṟa allatu metuvaṭaiya oṉṟōṭu oṉṟu kalantu urukkappaṭṭa ulōkaṅkaḷ kalappu ulōkaṅkaḷākum.
turuvēṟāta eḵku: (Stainless steel) urukkōṭu kurōmiyaṅkalanta kalavai. itu kaṟukkātu. paḷapaḷappāka virukkum. itu perumpālum pāttira vakaikaḷ ceyyappayaṉpaṭukiṟatu. cattira vaittiyattukku vēṇṭiya karuvikaḷum itaṉāṟ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pāriyam: oru ulōt taṉimam. itu varṇak kaittoḻilukkum cāyaṅkaḷ (Paints) ceyvataṟkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
veṇkalam: cempum veḷḷīyamuṅ kalanta kalavai. cempōṭu a tika veḷḷīyattaik kalanta kalavai (30-40%) i°pekkulam ulōkam (Speculum Metal) eṉavum,veṇkalattōṭu ciṟitu nākattaik cērttuc ceyyum kalavai tuppākki veṇkalam (Gun Metal) eṉavumpaṭum.
iracāyaṉam viññāṉam mutaliyaṉa
akar: (Ager) kiḻakku nāṭukaḷiluḷḷa cenniṟak kaṭaṟpāci oṉṟiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum pacaipōṉṟa oru poruḷ. itu nilaiyāṉa vaṭivamil lāta poruḷāyiruppiṉum teḷivāṉa tōṟṟamuḷḷatu. itu tūḷāka allatu kaṭṭiyākak kaṭaikaḷiṟ kiṭaikkum. itu nīrai atikam uṭ koṇṭu perukkiṟatu; vennīril eḷitiṟ karaikiṟatu. uṇavilum pala vakai miṭṭāykaḷilum pāliliruntu ceyyappaṭum poruḷkaḷilum itu cērkkappaṭukiṟatu.
aciṭṭik amilam: (Acetic Acid) itu muṟkālam mutal kāṭi eṉṉum peyariṉāl aṟiyappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu viṉākiriyilum vēṟu pala poruḷkaḷilumiruntum ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. itu perumpālum uṇavup poruḷkaḷaik keṭāmal pātukākkum muṟaikaḷukkum, ceyaṟkaip paṭṭuc ceyvataṟkum vēṟu palavakaikaḷukkum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. itu uṭaliṟpaṭṭāl tōlaip puṇṇākkum.
aciṭṭōṉ (Acetone): itu marattiliruntu vaṭitteṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. nīriḻivu nōyāḷiyiṉ ciṟu nīril cila camayaṅkaḷil itu kāṇappaṭuva tuṇṭu. cellulō°, naiṭrēṭṭu, koḻuppukkaḷ, piḷā°ṭikkukaḷ, aciṭṭilīṉ mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ karaippāṉāka itu utavukiṟatu.
aṇu: aṇuveṉpatu mēṟkoṇṭu pirikkamuṭiyāta mika nuṇṇiya caṭap poruḷiṉ kūṟu. aṇuviṉ naṭuvil oru karuvum karuvaic cuṟṟi ilekṭrāṉkaḷumuṇṭu. karuviluḷḷa miṉcāra caktikku ataṉaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa ellā elakrāṉkaḷiṉ miṉcāra cakti camamāka irukkum. karuvaic cuṟṟi irelakrāṉkaḷ kirakaṅkaḷaippōlac cuṟṟivantu koṇṭirukkum. ellāt taṉi aṇukkaḷai uṭaittālum orēvakai miṉ catti veḷiyākiṟatu.
aṇuniṟai: (Atomic Weight) oru taṉimattiṉ aṇuviṟkum oru tiṭṭat taṉimattiṉ aṇuviṟkumuḷḷa oppu niṟai ataṉ aṇuniṟai eṉap paṭum. ākciciṉ aṇu niṟai 16.0000 eṉakkoṇṭu aṇu niṟaikaḷ kuṟikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉpaṭi haiṭiracaṉ aṇuviṉ niṟai 1.0080.
aṇucakti: aṇukkaḷai veṟuṅkaṇṇiṉāl pārkka muṭiyātu. in nuṇ ṇiya aṇukkaḷai viññāṉa muṟaiyiṉāl piḷantāl aḷaviṭa muṭiyāta miṉcatti veḷivarukiṉṟatu. ik koḷkaiyaip piṉpaṟṟi aṇukuṇṭu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. ic caktiyai aḻivu vēlaikkup payaṉ paṭuttuvatu pōlavē ākka vēlaikkum payaṉpaṭuttalām.
aṇṭicepṭikku: (Antiseptics) puṇṇai allatu kāyattaik kaḻuvik kaṭṭiṉāl tīya pākṭīriyākkaḷ perukāmal taṭukkum maruntu.
attar: urōcāppū itaḻkaḷait taṇṇīriliṭṭu vālaivaṭi ceytapiṉ mēlē mitakkum eṇṇeyp poruḷ. 340 urōcāp pūviliruntu oru iṟāttal itaḻ kiṭaikkum. itiliruntu iraṇṭu tuḷi attar kiṭaikkum. palkēriyā, pirāṉcu, ciriyā, īrāṉ, turukki, intiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷil urōcā payiriṭappaṭukiṟatu. attar mukkiya vācaṉaip poruḷ.
apiṉi: kacakacāc ceṭiyiṉ iḷaṅkāyaik kīṟi vaṭiyum pālai eṭuttu ularttic cērkkappaṭuvatu apiṉi eṉappaṭum. pāracīkam, intiyā, turukki, yukō cilāvākkiyā, māciṭōṉiyā, palkēriyā, cīṉā, āciyāmaiṉar mutaliya nāṭukaḷil itu eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. apiṉiyai uṭkoṇṭāl mayakkamuṇṭākum.
amilaṅkaḷ: (Acids) oruvakai iracāyaṉap poruḷkaḷ. iliṭma° (Litmas) eṉṉum cāyattai nīlattiliruntu civappākkak kūṭiyavai. puḷippāṉa cuvaiyuṭaiyavai. ivaṟṟil haiṭiraciṉum vēṟu oṉṟiraṇṭu taṉimaṅ kaḷum kalantirukkum. itaṉai uppākkuvataṟku haiṭiraciṉukkup patil oru ulōkattaip piratiyīṭu ceyyalām. haiṭiraciṉukkup patil nākattaic cērttāl nākacalpaiṭṭu uṇṭākum. calparik, naiṟṟik, haiṭirōkuḷōrik amilaṅkaḷ arikkum taṉmaiyuṭaiyaṉa. ciṟṟik, tārtārik, acaṟṟik amilaṅkaḷ uṇavukaḷ carikkaṭṭuvataṟkum, pāṉa vakaikaḷukkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. kārpalik amilam mika upayōkamāṉa kirumi nācaṉi.
appirakam: ulōka vakaikaḷiloṉṟu. itu kaṇṇāṭi pōṉṟu, takaṭāka uṭaittu eṭukkakkūṭiyatu. itil oruvakai oḷiyaip pukaviṭum. itu nekiḻvum mīḷ caktiyumuṭaiya tiṇmam: intiyāvilum ilaṅkaiyi lum kiṭaikkiṟatu. mañcaḷ, paccai, civappu, paḻuppu, kaṟuppu niṟaṅkaḷuṭai yavai uṇṭu. oḷiyaip pukaviṭun taṉmaiyum, tīyai etirkkun tiṟaṉum veppanilai māṟṟaṅkaḷāl pātikkappaṭāta taṉmaiyumuṭaiya itu aṭuppukaḷilum viḷakkukaḷilum, caṉṉal katavukaḷilum,mōṭṭār vaṇṭikaḷiṉ muṉ tiraikaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟatu.
ampar: (Amber) kōṭikkaṇakkāṉa āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ uyiruḷḷa maraṅkaḷiliruntu vaṭinta piciṉkaḷ nilattuḷ kiṭantu mañcaṭ paḻuppu niṟamāka māṟiyuḷḷaṉa. ivai ampar eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ampar pālṭik kaṭaṟ pakutikaḷiṟ kiṭaikkiṟatu. ampar poṭi ceytu merukeṇṇey kaḷilum cāyaṅkaḷilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
ampar: (Ambergris) itu orkkōlai, mīṉampar eṉavum paṭum. itu i°pēm timiṅkilattiṉ kuṭaliliruntu varum meḻuku pōṉṟa poruḷ. itu cila camayaṅkaḷil kaḻivup poruḷākat timiṅkilattiṉ vayiṟṟiṉiṉṟu vantu nīril mitantu koṇṭirukkum. itu vācaṉaip poruḷkaḷ ceyyappayaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
ammaippāl kuttutal: māṭṭammaip pālai viññāṉa muṟaiyil payaṉpaṭuttuvataik kaṇṭupiṭittavar āṅkila vaittiyar eṭvārṭṭu ceṉṉar (1749 - 1823). ip pāl kuttappaṭṭavarukkup periyammai uṇṭākātu. ammainōy oruvakai vairacāl uṇṭākiṟatu.
ammōṉiyā: (Ammonia) naiṭraciṉ, haiṭraciṉ campantamāṉa kalavai; itu kāṟṟilum pātikaṉaṅ kuṟaintatu; nīril karaiyak kūṭiyatu. uṟaiyum nilaikkuc ciṟitu kūṭiya veppa nilaiyuḷḷa nīr 1,150 kaṉaaḷavu am mōṉiya vāyuvaik kalantu koḷḷum. ik kalavai tirava ammō ṉiyā eṉappaṭum.
ayōṭiṉ: (Iodine) itu kaṭaṟṟāvaraṅkaḷilum, veṭiyuppu kaṉiyaṅkaḷi liruntum peṟappaṭum karunīlamāṉa paṭikam. itu maruntu vakai kaḷukkum cāyaṅkaḷukkum payaṉākiṉṟatu.
arkaṉ: (Argon) kāṟṟil kāṇappaṭum vāyu. itu vēṟet taṉimaṅkaḷōṭum cēramāṭṭātu.
alaṅkārap poruḷkaḷ: vācaṉait tailaṅkaḷ, vācaṉaip pacaikaḷ, mukappoṭikaḷ, mukappacaikaḷ itaḻc cāyam, kaṉṉac cāyam, nakameruku, puruva mai, paṟpacai, mayirnīkki mutaliyaṉa.
alkahāl: (Alcohol) itu cātāraṇamāka carkkarai allatu i°ṭārccōṭu ī°ṭṭaik kalantu notikka viṭuvatāl kiṭaikkiṟatu. uvaiṉ, pīyar pōṉṟa kuṭivakaikaḷil veṟiyai uṇṭākkum poruḷ alkahāl eṉappaṭum. itu nalla karaippāṉ (Solvent); itu merukeṇṇeyk kum (vāṇiṣ) maruntukaḷukkum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum.
ampumeṉ: (Albumen) itu oruvakaip purōṭṭiṉ (Protein); nīril karaiyak kūṭiyatu. ivvakaiyiloṉṟu muṭṭaiyiṉ veṇkaru. itu veppam, amilam, alkahāl campantamāṉāl kaṭṭiyākum.
aṉiliṉ (Aniline): itu nilakkarit tāriliruntu eṭukkappaṭum peṉciṉ (Benzene) eṉṉum tiravattiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum niṟamaṟṟa eṇṇeyp poruḷ. palavakaic ceyaṟkaic cāyam ceyvataṟku itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
ā°piriṉ: cācilik amilam eṉṟa iracāyaṉap poruḷ. vāṇipattil ā°piriṉ eṉa vaḻaṅkiṉṟatu. itu talaivali, kāyccal, taṭimaṉ mutaliya nōykaḷukku maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
iracavātam: (Alchemy) itu paḻaṅkāla iracāyaṉa muṟai. itu tāḻnta ulōka vakaikaḷait taṅkamāka māṟṟuvatum uṭalai yaḻiyāmalirukkac ceyvatumākiya maruntaik kaṇṭupiṭippataṟku muṟkālattavar ceytu vanta ārāycci muṟaikaḷ. ivvakai ārāycci maruntuc carakkukaḷai erippatum avaṟṟaip piṟitoṉṟōṭu kalappatumākiya taṉmaika ḷuṭaiyatāka viruntatu. immuṟaikaḷē ikkāla iracāyaṉa cāttirat tikku vaḻikāṭṭiyākavuḷḷaṉa.
ilaippaccai: itu tāvaraṅkaḷiṟkāṇum paccai niṟapporuḷ. paccai niṟamuḷḷa tāvaraṅkaḷ itaṉutaviyāl cūriya oḷiyiluḷḷa caktiyaik koṇṭu nīraiyum kārpaṉ ṭai yākcaiṭṭaiyum kūṭṭic carkkarai ākiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷaic camaittuk koḷḷum. icceyal oḷic cērkkai eṉappaṭum.
iṉculiṉ: (Inisulin) itu iraippaikkuk kīḻuḷḷa cavviliruntu curakkum oruvakai iracāyaṉa nīr. ipporuḷ curakkā viṭṭāl carkkarai aḷavukku miñci irattattil ōṭic ciṟunīrccurappikaḷ vaḻiyāka mūttirattil veḷic ceṉṟuviṭum; nīriḻivu nōyuṇṭākum. āṭumāṭu, paṉṟi mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ iṉculiṉ ataṟku maruntākiṟatu. ataṉai ūcikuttic celuttuvārkaḷ.
ūtuvatti: vācaṉaipporuḷ, marattūḷ eṉpavai kalantu ceyyappaṭum kuccukaḷ. cātāraṇa ūtuvattiyil 30% cantaṉat tūḷum 20% akil marattūḷum, 5% kiccilik kiḻaṅkum, 5% veṭṭivērum, 10% mēṟ kuṟippiṭṭa ilaikaḷum pūkkaḷum, 20% paṟaṅkic cāmpirāṇiyum 10% kariyum piṟaporuḷkaḷumuṇṭu. uyarntavakai vattikaḷukku ampar, vācaṉait tailaṅkaḷ, ka°tūri, puṉuku mutaliya poruḷkaḷum cērum.
oṭṭuvarṇam: (Distemper) vaccirappacai, taṇṇīr, cīmaic cuṇṇāmpu ākiyavaṟṟaik kalantu ceyyappaṭum kalavai. taṭitta pacai allatu tūḷvaṭivil oṭṭu varṇam viṟkappaṭukiṟatu.
oppaṭartti: (Specific gravity) oru poruḷiṉ niṟaikkum atē parumaṉ koṇṭa 40 veppanilaiyiluḷḷa nīriṉ niṟaikkumuḷḷa vikitam. tiravap poruḷkaḷukku nīr ittakaiya tiṭapporuḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. vāyuviṉ aṭarttiṟku mutalil haiṭiraciṉuṭaṉ oppiṭappaṭṭatu. ippoḻutu itu ākcicaṉuṭaṉ oppiṭappaṭukiṟatu.
oḷiccērkkai: (Photosynthesis) paccait tāvaraṅkaḷ tam ilai mutaliya uṟuppukaḷiluḷḷa paccaiyam eṉṉum niṟamiyiṉ utaviyiṉāl cūriya veḷiccattiṉiṉṟum peṟum caktiyaik koṇṭu nīraiyum kariyamila vāyuvaiyum kūṭṭic carkkarai allatu māppaṇṭamākiya kārpō haiṭirēṭṭu eṉṉum poruḷait tokukkum ceyal. oḷiyiṉ ceya lāl poruḷkaḷ tokukkappaṭutaliṉ icceyal oḷiccērkkai eṉappaṭukiṟatu.
oṭikkalōṉ: (Eau de Cologne) vācaṉaiyuḷḷa tiravap poruḷ. kolōṉ (ittāli) eṉṉumiṭattil ceyyap paṭuvatāl itaṟku oṭikkalōṉ eṉṉum peyar vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu. cuttamāṉa matuccāram (alkahāl) maruntuc carakkukaḷ, cila naṟumaṇapporuḷkaḷ, mūlikaikaḷ malarkaḷaik kāyccik kiyāḷam ceytu vālai vaṭittup piṉ takka aḷavil pala tāvarac carakkukaḷaiyum kalantu itu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu.
kālari: (Colorie) 100 kirām (2.2 pavuṇṭu) taṇṇīriṉ veppattai oru ceṇṭikirēṭṭu pākai uyarttum veppattiṉ aḷavu. itu pala vakai uṇavukaḷ uṭalil erivatāl uṇṭākum caktiyiṉ aḷavai alaku.
kāṟṟu: itu pala vāyukkaḷiṉ tokuppu. itil 78% naiṭṭiraciṉ, 21% ārkaṉ, kārpaṉ ṭai okcaiṭ 0.03% nīrāvi mutaliyaṉa uṇṭu. paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷukku aṇmaiyil itil karit tūcu, kantaka amilam, haiṭṭiraciṉ calpaiṭṭu mutaliyaṉa kāṇappaṭum. kāṟṟu pūmiyaic cūḻntirukkiṟatu. kāṟṟu iyaṅ kuvatāl atu vīcukiṟatu.
kirumi kollikaḷ: (Anticeptics) nōykaḷai uṇṭākkuvaṉavum, cuttattaik keṭuppaṉavumākiya nuṇkirumikaḷaik kollum poruḷ. ivai kāyaṅkaḷaik kaḻuvutal, cattira cikiccai ceyyum karuvikaḷ tuṇikaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟiluḷḷa kirumikaḷaik kollutal pōṉṟavaṟ ṟukkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum. porācik tūḷ (Borocic Powder), haiṭ ṭiraciṉ parekcaiṭ, ilaicol, kārpalik amilam mutaliyaṉa peritum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
koḻuppu: itu tāvaraṅkaḷilum, vilaṅkukaḷ paṟavaikaḷilum tōlukkuk kīḻirukkum. maṉitaṉiṭattil itu potuvāka eṅkuñ cērntirukkum. oṭṭakaṅkaḷukku itu mutukut tiraṇaiyāka virukkum. tāvaraṅkaḷiṉ koḻuppu eṇṇeyākak kiṭaikkiṟatu. maṟṟa uṇavukaḷilum pārkka eṇṇeyuṇavil atika caktiyuṇṭu.
kōppai maṇ: (Porcelain) itu ulōkak kalappillāta veḷḷaik kaḷimaṇ. immaṇṇiṉāl ceyyappaṭum pāttiraṅkaḷ cīṉap pāt tiraṅkaḷ eṉappaṭum. cīṉāvukkuc ceṉṟu mīṇṭa pirayāṇikaḷ koṇṭu ceṉṟa pāttiraṅkaḷaiyum maṇṇaiyum koṇṭu airōppiyar itaṉai aṟintaṉar. cīṉakkaḷi pōṉṟa maṇṇai mutalil airōppāvil tayārittavar potkar (Bottger) eṉṉum cermāṉiyar (1710.)
cīmaic cuṇṇāmpu: (Chalk) kaṭaṟ pirāṇikaḷiṉ ōṭukaḷiliruntu uṇṭāṉa cuṇṇāmpu. iṅkilāntil pala cōkku malaikaḷuṇṭu. ivai aintu kōṭi āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ kaṭaluṭ paṭinta kaṭaṟpirāṇikaḷiṉ oṭukaḷi liruntu uṇṭāṉavai.
ceyaṟkai nūlkaḷ: tāvarap poruḷkaḷiluḷḷa cellulōcai aṭippaṭai yākak koṇṭu ceyyappaṭum ceyaṟkai nūlkaḷ mutalil tōṉṟiṉa. ivai maṟuvaḷarccic collulō° iḻaikaḷ(regenerated celuose fibers) eṉappaṭum. irāyaṉ (rayon) eṉpatu ivaṟṟiṉ potup peyar. kaḻivup paṭṭaik karaittu akkaraiviliruntu nūlkaḷait tayārikkum muṟai cermaṉiyilum yappāṉilum vaḻaṅki varukiṉṟatu. tāvara allatu vilaṅkup poruḷkaḷallāta tokuppup poruḷkaḷiliruntu cey yappaṭum nūl nailāṉ eṉa vaḻaṅkukiṟatu. kaṇṇāṭiyiliruntum irappariliruntum nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. pāliluḷḷa kēcīṉ eṉṉum puroṭṭiṉiliruntum nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. ivai amerikkāvil arlāk (Arlac) eṉavum, ittāliyil ilāṉiṭṭāl (Lanidal) eṉavum vaḻaṅkiṉṟaṉa. cōyā avaraiyiliruntum nilak kaṭalaiyiliruntum ikkālattil tokuppu nūlkaḷ ceyyappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.
paṭṭu: cila pūccikaḷ puḻupparuva muḻu vaḷarcciyaṭainta piṉ tammuṭalaic cuṟṟi melliya nūlai nūṟṟuk kūṭukaṭṭik koḷkiṉṟaṉa. puḻukkaḷiṉ talaippākattiluḷḷa iru curappikaḷiliruntu varum nīr kāṟṟuppaṭṭa vuṭaṉ keṭṭiyāṉa nūlākiṉṟatu. ikkūṭukaḷiliruntu nūlaik kulait teṭuttu āṭaikaḷ neyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
pīyar: (beer) vāḷi muḷaiyaik notikka vaittuc ceyyappaṭum oruvakai matuvakai.
piḷā°ṭik: (Plastics) palavakaip poruḷkaḷiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum ceyaṟkaip pacaiyiliruntu peṟappaṭum poruḷ. itiliruntu mikap pala poruḷkaḷ ceyyappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.cellulōyiṭ eṉṉum poruḷai mutaliṟ ceyyak kaṇṭupiṭittavar parmiṅkāmil vāḻnta alekcāntar park° (Alexander Parkes-1855). maṇṇeṇṇey, maṇilākkoṭṭai, pāl, nilakkari, maram mutaliya pala poruḷkaḷ piḷā°ṭikkāka māṟṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. nailāṉ tuṇikaḷ, cīppukaḷ, teli pōṉkaḷ, pilmkaḷ mutaliya palaporuḷkaḷ itaṉāṟ ceyyap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
peṉiciliṉ: (Peniclin) palavakai nōykaḷaik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉ paṭuttappaṭum mikap payaṉuḷḷa maruntu. itu cilavakai nuṇ kirumi kaḷaip perukāmal taṭukkiṟatu. itu oruvakai pūñcak kāḷāṉiliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṉṟatu.
peṉciṉ: (Benzene) nilakkarit tāriliruntu eṭukkappaṭum niṟamillāta tiravam. itil irappar, piciṉ, koḻuppu mutaliyaṉa karaiyum. cāyaṅ kaḷum vēṟu pala poruḷkaḷum ceyvataṟku itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
mayir: itu pālūṭṭikaḷiṉ uṭaliṉ paraviyirukkum. itu tōliṉmītu oraḷavu kāṟṟaip piṭittu vaittu uṭaliṉ veppanilaiyaik kāppāṟ ṟum. kāṟṟu veppattai eḷitaṟ kaṭattāp poruḷkaḷuḷoṉṟu.
veṭimaruntu: veṭiyuppu, marakkari, kantakam eṉpavaṟṟiṉ kalavai. cīṉar itaip paḻaṅkālattilēyē payaṉpaṭuttiṉar. itaṉai airōppāvil ceyyak kaṇṭupiṭittavar cermaṉ tuṟavi (Monk) icvāṭ° (Schwartz). veṭimaruntu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum pala vēlaikaḷukku ippoḻutu iṭaiṉameṭ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.
kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ uruvac cilaikaḷ mutaliyaṉa
irāmcēciṉ periya uruvac cilai: (Colossi of Rameses II) ekiptiya araca ṉākiya iraṇṭām irāmcēciṉ nāṉku uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum vaṭivil maṇ kallil ki.mu.1270il veṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. ivai nail āṟṟiṉ iṭatu karaiyiluḷḷa apucāmvel eṉṉum kōyiliṉ pakutikaḷāka vuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟiṉ uyaram 70 aṭi.
ī°ṭar tīvu uruvac cilaikaḷ: teṉ pacipik kaṭaliluḷḷa ī°ṭar tīvukaḷil uruvac cilaikaḷ pala narai niṟakkaṟkaḷil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivaṟṟai eccātik kuriyavarkaḷ veṭṭiṉārkaḷ eṉṟu aṟiya muṭiyavillai. ī°ṭar tīvu teṉṉamerikkāviluḷḷa cilli nāṭṭiliruntu mēṟkē 2,000 mail tolaiviluḷḷatu. ivvuruvac cilaikaḷ 4 aṭi mutal 37 aṭi uyaramuṭaiyaṉa. ivai 200 mutal 300 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷa mēṭaikaḷ mītu vaikkappaṭṭirukkiṉṟaṉa.
urōṭ° tīviṉ periya uruvac cilai (Colossus of Rhodes): urōṭ° tīvil urōṭ° tuṟaimukattil ki.mu. 280il niṟuttappaṭṭa 103 aṭi uyaramuḷḷa veṇkalac cilai. itu kirēkkariṉ cūriyakkaṭavuḷākiya helō° kaṭavuḷaik kuṟippatu. ki.mu. 224il nērnta pūmi atircci yiṉpōtu itu viḻuntatu. iṉṉoru periya uruvac cilai nīrō (Nero) aracaṉuṭaiyatu. itu 110 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu; urōmil niṟuttap paṭṭatu.
urōm nakariṉ cēyiṉṭ pīṟṟar ālayam: itu ittāliyiṉ talainakarāṉa urōmiluḷḷatu; kiṟittuva tēvālayaṅkaḷ ellāvaṟṟilum periyatu. itu 18,000 catura aṭi parappai mūṭik kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itu iraṇṭām yūliya° eṉṉum pōppiṉ kālattil 1,450il toṭaṅki 1632il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. itaṉ nīḷam 6,336 aṭi; uyaram 435 aṭi; uḷḷēyuḷḷa palipīṭattiṉ uyaram 95 aṭi. itu 54,000 pēr niṉṟu vaṇaṅkuvataṟku iṭamaḷikkak kūṭiyatu. 
ekiptiya piramiṭṭuc camātikaḷ: (Pyramids of Egypt) ivai nīla natiyiṉ mēṟkuk karaiyil kicē (Gizesh) eṉṉumiṭattil toṭaṅki aṟupatu mail tūrattil paravik kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa.ivai ki.mu.3500 mutal ki.mu.1800 varai parōvā eṉappaṭṭa aracariṉ uṭalkaḷai aṭakkañceyvataṟkuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa kallaṟaikaḷ. kirēkkarkaḷāl kuvu eṉappaṭṭa ciyap° (Cheops) aracaṉāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa camāti. 450 aṭi uyaramum taḷattil 746 aṭi caturamumuḷḷatu. itu 13 ēkkar nilattai mūṭi niṟkiṉṟatu. itu 2,300,000kku mēṟpaṭṭa nīlak kaṟpāṟaikaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
epuceciluḷḷa tayaṉā ālayam: (Temple at Diana at Epueses) āciyā maiṉaril epuce° eṉṉumiṭattil ayōṉiyarāl ki.mu.5ām nūṟ ṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyil. itu 425 aṭi nīḷamum 225 aṭi akala mum uṭaiyatāka viruntatu. kūraiyait tāṅkiya tūṇ ovvoṉṟum 60 aṭi uyaramum 150 toṉ eṭaiyumuḷḷaṉa.
empayar °ṭēṭpilṭiṅ: (Empire State Building) niyuyōk paṭṭiṉatti luḷḷatu. itaṉ uyaram 1,250 aṭi. itaṟku 102 māṭikaḷuṇṭu. ituvē ulakil mika uyarnta kaṭṭaṭam. itu 1931il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. 86vatu māṭiyiliruntu pārttāl 25mail tolaiviluḷḷa kāṭcikaḷ tōṉṟum.
olimpa°malaic ciya° uruvaccilai: (Statue of Zeus at Olympus) ki.mu. 4ām nūṟṟāṇṭil piṭiya° amaitta ciya° kaṭavuḷariṉ uruvaccilai olimpa° malaiyil vaikkappaṭṭiruntatu. itu calavaik kal, tantam, poṉ mutaliyavaikaḷāl ceyyappaṭṭu 58 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatāka viruntatu. itaṉ cimmācaṉam pala maṇikaḷāl alaṅkarikkappaṭ ṭiruntatu. iccilaiyaik kiṟittuva paṭai eṭuppāḷar aḻittaṉar.
kalikkār nācaciṉ camāti: (Mausoleum of Halicarnassus) peṭram (Bedrum) eṉappaṭum kalikkār nācacil (āciyā maiṉar) ārtimiciyā eṉṉum irāṇi taṉatu kaṇavaṉ moca lōcacukku ki.mu.352il calavaik kaṟ camāti oṉṟu kaṭṭiṉāḷ. itu 140 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itu 12ām nūṟ ṟāṇṭilum, 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭilum nērnta pūmi atircciyil aḻintu pōyiṟṟu.
kūvar aṇaikkaṭṭu (Hoover Damd): itu pōlṭarṭām eṉavum vaḻaṅkum. itu kolaraṭō āṟṟiṉ aricōṉāvilum nevēṭāvilumuḷḷatu. ivvaṇaikkaṭṭiṉ uyaram 727 aṭi; nīḷam 1180 aṭi. itu pattuk kōṭi kalaṉ nīr piṭikkak kūṭiyatu; 1935-l tiṟakkappaṭṭatu. itu ulakil mikapperiya aṇaikkaṭṭu. 4,400,000 kaṉa yār (kacam) kāṉ kirīṭ itaik kaṭṭap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
cāntā cōpiyāp paḷḷivācal: (Mosque of Santa Sophia) ya°tiṉiyaṉ (Justinian)eṉṉum cakkaravarttiyāl 6ām nūṟṟāṇṭil koṉ°tānti ṉōppiḷil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭaṭamoṉṟuḷḷatu. iraṇṭām mukamatu eṉṉum turukkic cultāṉ in nakaraip piṭittapōtu avaṉ ataṉaip paḷḷi vācalāka māṟṟiṉāṉ (1453). itaṉ uṭpuṟaṅkaḷ cuvar oviyaṅka ḷālum calavaik kaṟkaḷālum alaṅkarikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. mattiya kummaṭṭam 108 aṭi uyaramum 107 aṭi viṭṭamumuḷḷatu.
cīṉap peruñcuvar: (Great wall of China) kallālum maṇṇālum kaṭṭi veḷiyē ceṅkal aḻuttappaṭṭa 1,400 mail nīṇṭa cuvar. itu cīṉā vukkum maṅkōliyāvukkum ellaiyākavuḷḷatu. itaik kaṭṭum vēlai ṣi havāṅ eṉṉum cīṉac cakkaravarttiyāl toṭakkappaṭṭatu. ic cuvariṉ perumpakuti miṅ vamica aracar kālattil (1368-1644) kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. ovvoru 300 aṭi tūrattukku oṉṟākap pala 40 aṭi uyaramuḷḷa kāvaṟ kōpuraṅkaḷuḷḷaṉa. aṭittaḷattil kaṉam 25 aṭi mutal 15 aṭi varaiyil māṟupaṭukiṉṟatu. uyaram 20 mutal 30 aṭi. cuvar nuṉiyiṉ akalam 15 aṭi. cuvariṉ ucciyil 10 aṭi akalamuḷḷa pātaiyuṇṭu. itu ki.mu. 3ām nūṟṟāṇṭil toṭaṅkappaṭṭatu.
cērka° mākcima°: (Circus Maximus) itu urōmil ki.mu. 605il kaṭṭap paṭṭa nāṭaka araṅku. itu yūliyar cīcarāl periyatākkap paṭṭatu. itu 1875 aṭi nīḷamum 625 aṭi akalamum, 150,000 pēr irukka iṭa vacatiyu muḷḷatu. iṅku vaṇṭiccavāri, uṭaṟpayiṟci viḷaiyāṭṭukaḷ naṭai peṟṟaṉa.
tācmakāl: itu kummaṭṭaṅkaḷuḷḷa caturavaṭivāṉa kallaṟai. itu calavaik kallāl 1629kkum 1650kkumiṭaiyil cācakāṉ eṉṉum mukamatiya aracaṉāl taṉatu maṉaivi mumtaci makāliṉ camātiyāka akkirāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. itu civanta kaṟkaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭa matilkaḷuṭaiya tōṭṭattiṉ naṭuvē 210 aṭi uyaramuṭaiyatāka viḷaṅkukiṉṟatu. itaṉ taḷam 313 aṭi caturamuḷḷatu. kaṭṭiṭattiṉ uṭpuṟaṅkaḷ palavakai irattiṉakkaṟkaḷ patittu alaṅkarikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
tipettiya pōtalam: (Pothala of Tibet) itu tipettiṉ āṭcit talai varākiya talailāmāviṉ iruppiṭam. itu 900 aṭi nīḷamuṭaiyatāy kōṭṭaipōṉṟa tōṟṟamuṭaiyatu. itaṟku mulām pūciya pala kūrai kaḷum palvēṟu uyaramuḷḷa kōpuraṅkaḷumuṇṭu. mika uyarnta kōpuratti ṉuyaram 400 aṭi. pōtalattiṉ veḷippuṟam civappu niṟamum uṭpuṟam veṇṇiṟamu muṭaiyaṉa.
nāṅkiṅ veḷḷaik kaḷimaṇ kōpuram (Porcelain tower of Nanking) itu yuṅlō eṉṉum cīṉac cakkaravarttiyāl kiḻakkuc cīṉāviluḷḷa nāṉkiṅ eṉṉumiṭattil 15ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭatu. eṭṭu mūlaiyaiyuṭaitu. itaṉ uyaram 261 aṭi. itaṟku eṭṭu allatu oṉpatu māṭikaḷiruntaṉa. itaṉ iṟappukaḷil 152 maṇikaḷum 152 kaṇṇāṭi viḷakkukaḷum toṅkaviṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. itu 1853il puraṭcikkārarāl aḻikkappaṭṭatu.
paḻaṅkālak kaṭṭukkālvāy (Ancient Aqueduct): kiṟittuva āṇṭukku muṉṉum piṉṉum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷukku nīr utavuvataṟkup pala kaṭṭuk kāl vāykaḷ veṭṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa. ivvakaik kālvāy mutalil eyupāliṉa° (Eupalenus) eṉpavaṉāl ki.mu.630il veṭṭappaṭṭatu. atu āciyā maiṉarukku aṇmaiyiluḷḷa cāmō° eṉṉum kirēkka tīvukku nīr koṭuttatu. urōm nakarukku oṉpatu kālvāy kaḷāl tiṉamum 40,000 kalaṉ nīr pōyk koṇṭiruntatu. paḻaṅkāla ekiptiyar, pāpilōṉiyar, erucalēmiyarkaḷum kaṭṭuk kālvāy kaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉārkaḷ.
paḻaṅkālak kirēkkak kūttumēṭaikaḷ: ki.mu. 4ām nūṟṟāṇṭil pala kūttuk kaḷarikaḷ kirīcil kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. avaṟṟukkuk kūrai illai. avai arai vaṭṭavaṭiviṉa. aṅku kalliṉāṟ ceyyappaṭṭa ācaṉaṅ kaḷ nilaiyākap pōṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa. (i) ṭaiyōṉi ca° kaḷari 16,000 pēr irukkak kūṭiyatāka viruntatu.
pāpilōṉ toṅku tōṭṭam: (Hanging garden of Babylon) yupirāta° āṟṟukku aṇmaiyil ippoḻutu īrākkukkut teṟkiluḷḷa pāk tāttukkut teṟkē nepuccaṇ nēcar eṉṉum pāpilōṉiya aracaṉ tūṇkaḷmītu kaṭṭappaṭṭa māṭikaḷil oru pūntōṭṭattai ki.mu. 600il amaittāṉ. aṭukkaṭukkāka amainta kaṭṭukaḷ 75aṭi mutal 300 aṭi varai uyaramuṭaiyaṉavāka viruntaṉa. mika uyarnta iṭattil māṭi yil vaikkappaṭṭirunta nīrt tēkkattiliruntu kuḻāykaḷ mūlam ceṭi kaḷukku nīr viṭappaṭṭatu.
periya maṉitamukac ciṅkam: (Great sphinx) itu vaṭa ekiptil kicē eṉṉu miṭattil paṭuttirukkum pāvaṇaiyil malaiyil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷa maṉitamukacciṅkam. cepraṉ eṉṉum parōvā itaṉai ki.mu. 3500il veṭṭuvittāṉ. itaṉ uṭaliṉ nīḷam 189 aṭiyum, mukattiṉ kuṟuk kaḷavu 13 aṭi 8 aṅkulamum, vāyiṉ akalam 5 aṭi 7 aṅkulamumuḷḷaṉa. 50 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷa ataṉ muṉṉaṅkālkaḷiṉiṭaiyē kāṟṟaṭittuk koṇṭuvanta maṇ kuvintuḷḷatu. itu ñāyiṟṟuk kaṭavuḷaik kuṟikkum ciṉṉam eṉak karutappaṭukiṉṟatu.
pāra° kalaṅkarai viḷakkam: (Pharos of Alexandria) itu tālami pilāṭipa° eṉṉum aracaṉāl ki.mu. 247il alakcāntiriyāt tuṟaimukattukku aṇmaiyiluḷḷa pāra° (Pharos) tīvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa veḷicca vīṭu. itu ki.pi. 1375il nērnta pūmi atircciyiṉāl aḻiveytiyatu.
paicā cāynta kōpuram: (Leaning tower of Pisa) itu ittāliyiṉ teṉmēṟkuk karaiyilirukkum paicāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷa vaṭṭa vaṭivāṉa eṭṭu māṭikkōpuram. itu nēr kuttiliruntu 15 aṭi vilaki niṟkiṉṟatu. itaṉ vaṭakkup pakkattiṉ uyaram 181 aṭi; teṟkup pakkat tiṉ uyaram 179 aṭi. itu 1173il toṭaṅki 1350il muṭikkappaṭṭatu. camīpakālattil 1000 toṉ eṭaiyuḷḷa cimeṇṭu itaṉ taḷattuṭ celuttappaṭṭuḷḷatu. vaṭa ittāliyil polakṉā(Bologna)vil oṉṟum, kiḻakkuc cuviṟcalāntil moṭriṭ° (St.Motritze) cil oṉṟumāka vēṟu iru carinta kōpuraṅkaḷum irukkiṉṟaṉa.
porō putūr: (Boro Budor) itu intu-yāvāvil pōrō putūr eṉṉu miṭattil erimalaik kuḻampup pāṟaiyil ki.pi. 8ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa pautta kōyil. ikkaṭṭiṭam 150 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu. itaic cuṟṟi ēḻu matilkaḷ paṭikkaṭṭuppōl kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟiṉ naṭuvē 52 aṭi viṭṭamuḷḷa tātu kōpam eḻukiṉṟatu. kōviliṉ ovvoru pakkamum 520 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷatu.puttariṉ uruvaṅkaḷ vaikkappaṭṭuḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷil pala tūpikaḷum oṭuṅkiya kōpuraṅkaḷum eḻukiṉṟaṉa. avai ik kōyilaik kuṇṭūci kuttiya mettaipōlak kāṭciyaḷikkac ceykiṉṟaṉa.
mammattuk kukai: (Mammoth Cave) itu aikkiya amerikkāvil keṉtakki eṉṉumiṭattiluḷḷatu. ik kukaiyil nūṟumail tūram kaṇṭaṟiyap paṭṭuḷḷatu. ik kukaiyil kōyileṉappaṭum iṭattiluḷḷa kummaṭṭam 120 aṭi uyaramum 5 ēkkar parappumuḷḷatu.
malaiccikara vācikaḷiṉ araṇmaṇai: (“Place” of the cliff dwellers) kolara ṭōvil māṉkō° (Mancos) eṉṉumiṭattil paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷāṟ kaṭṭappaṭṭa paḻaiya kirāmamoṉṟuḷḷatu. iṅku ippoḻutu makkaḷ naṭamāṭṭamillai. iṅkuḷḷa kaṭṭaṭattil 200 periya aṟaikaḷum 22 ciṟiya aṟaikaḷumuḷḷaṉa. ik kaṭṭaṭattai amaikkappaṭṭa kottu vēlaiyai nōkkumpōtu aṅku vāḻnta makkaḷ uyarnta nākarikam peṟṟiruntārkaḷeṉat terikiṟatu.
māyā makkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷ: mattiya amerikkāvil māyāmakkaḷ eḻuppiya kōyilkaḷ ammakkaḷ uyarnta nākarikam peṟṟiruntārka ḷeṉpataik kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa. ik kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ cuṇṇāmpum maṇalum kalantu kuḻaitta cāntiṉālum cuṇṇāmpuk kalliṉālum kaṭṭappaṭ ṭuḷḷaṉa. ippoḻutu aḻintu kiṭakkum kaṭṭaṭaṅkaḷ piramiṭṭuc camā tikaḷ pōṉṟa uyarnta mēṭaikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷaṉa. kaṭṭaṅkaḷiṉ tūṇkaḷ iṟakkai muḷaitta pāmpukaḷ pōṉṟa tōṟṟamuṭaiyavai. māyā makkaḷiṉ kaṭṭaṭak kalaikkum teṉṉintiya ciṟpakkalaikkum uṟavu kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.
memmoṉiṉ iraṭṭai uruvac cilaikaḷ: (Twin Colossi of Memmon) ameṉ hotap parōvāviṉ iraṇṭu uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum nilaiyil maṇkallil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa (ki.mu.14ām nū.). ivai ekiptiṉ vaṭakiḻakkiluḷḷa karnākkiluḷḷaṉa. poḻutu tōṉṟum nērattil ivai aḻuvatu pōṉṟa ōcai ceykiṉṟaṉa. kuḷirnta kallil veyil veppam paṭuvatāl ivvāṟu ōcai eḻukiṉṟatu eṉṟu collappaṭukiṟatu. ivvōcai memmoṉ teyvattiṉ cīḻkkai eṉak kirēkkar nampi vantaṉar.
maicūriluḷḷa periya uruvac cilai: camaṇa matam cammantappaṭṭa kōma tēcuvarar uruvaccilai maicūril 470 aṭi uyarnta malaic cikaratti luḷḷa pāṟaiyil veṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉ uyaram 60 aṭi; tōṭ paṭṭaiyiluḷḷa akalam 26 aṭi. itu camaṇak kaṭavuḷ campantappaṭṭatu.
viṭutalaic cilai (Statue of Liberty): itu niyuyōkkiluḷḷa peṭlō° (Bedloes) tīvil niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷa periya cilai. itu pireñcu aracāṅ kattāl amerikkā viṭutalaiyaṭainta nūṟāvatu āṇṭu viḻāviṉ pōtu amerikkāvukku aṉpaḷippākak koṭukkap paṭṭatu. itu oru peṇ vaṭivam; viṭutalaic cūḷai uyarttip piṭittuk koṇṭu niṟpa tāka amaintuḷḷatu. itu tuṟaimukattukku mēl 310 aṭi uyara muḷḷatu. itu 3.32 aṅkulat taṭippuṭaiyatākavum, uḷ veḷiyuṭaiya tākavum ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷatu. itaṉ eṭai 225 toṉ. kīḻ iruntu mēlvarai paṭikkaṭṭukaḷuḷḷaṉa.
palporuḷ
akac civappuk katirkaḷ: (Infra red rays) cūriya oḷiyiṉ niṟamālaiyil alai nīḷam atikamāṉa civappup pakutikku appāl kaṇṇukkup pulap paṭātuḷḷa katirkaḷ ippeyar peṟum.
akṭōpar puraṭci: 1917il uruciyāviṉ talainakarākavirunta peṭrō kirāṭṭil naṭanta pōlṣavik puraṭci ippeyar peṟum.
acceḻuttukkaḷiṉ puḷḷi: acceḻuttukkaḷiṉ aḷavu puḷḷi eṉappaṭu kiṟatu. 72 puḷḷikaḷ ōr aṅkula nīḷamākum. cātāraṇamākap puttakaṅkaḷ 11 allatu 12 puḷḷikaḷil acciṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
acaṟkuṟippu: viyāpārikaḷ kaṇakkup puttakaṅkaḷilum pēreṭṭilum patiyumuṉ pativu ceyyappaṭum ovvoru viyāpāra naṭavaṭikkaiyum aṭaṅkiya puttakam eṉappaṭum.
aṭitoṭṭi: (Slaughter house) cukātāra muṟaiyil āṭu māṭukaḷai aṭittu māmicattaip peṟuvataṟkāka amaikkappaṭṭa kaṭṭaṭam. itaṟkāka aracāṅkam ēṟpaṭuttum vitikaḷuṇṭu. ulakil periya aṭi toṭṭi cikākō nakaril (amerikkā) uḷḷatu.
aṭimai nilai: mikap paḻaṅkālam mutal aṭimaikaḷ iruntu vantārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ perumpālum pōrkaḷil piṭikkappaṭṭa pakaivarkaḷāka viruntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ āṭu māṭukaḷaip pōla viṟkavum vāṅkavum paṭṭārkaḷ. mēṟku nāṭukaḷiṟ palar āppirikkāviliruntu aṭimai kaḷaip piṭittu viṟkum viyāpārattil īṭupaṭṭiruntaṉar. amerik kāvilum mēṟkintiyat tīvukaḷilum veḷḷaiyariṉ paṇṇaikaḷil vēlaiceyvōr aṭimaikaḷākavē iruntārkaḷ. amerikkāvil 1865il aṭimai oḻippuc caṭṭam ceyyappaṭṭatu. appoḻutu 45 ilaṭcam aṭimaikaḷ viṭutalai peṟṟārkaḷ. iṅkilāntil 1792ilum piriṭṭiṣ kuṭiyēṟṟa nāṭukaḷil 1833ilum 1834il intiyāvilum aṭimai oḻikkappaṭṭatu.
aṭaiyāṟu nūl nilaiyam: ceṉṉaikkup pakkattiluḷḷa aṭaiyāṟu eṉṉumiṭattil piramañāṉa caṅkattārāl niṟuvappaṭṭa nūl nilaiyam. itil 76,713 nūlkaḷuṇṭu.
aṭmiral: aikkiya amerikkā, iṅkilāntu eṉṉum nāṭukaḷait tavira maṟṟaiya nāṭukaḷil aṭmiral eṉpatu kaṭaṟpaṭaiyiṉ talaimai atikāriyaik kuṟikka vaḻaṅkum peyar. amerikkā, iṅkilāntu eṉ ṉum nāṭukaḷil kaṭaṟpaṭai aṭmiral eṉpatu talaimaip pataviyākum. kaṭaṟpaṭaiyil aṭmiral eṉpatu taraippaṭaiyil ceṉaral eṉpatu pōṉṟatu.
aṇaikkaṭṭu: oru āṟṟiṉ pōkkait taṭuttuvaittu ataṉ maṭṭat taiyum aḷavaiyum kaṭṭuppaṭuttavum, nīrait tēkki vaittup payaṉ paṭuttavum ataṉ kuṟukkē pōṭappaṭum taṭai.
atlāntik uṭaṉpaṭikkai: itu 1949il mēṟku airōppāviluḷḷa nāṭukaḷukkum vaṭa amerikkāvukkumiṭaiyē ēṟpaṭṭa ōr oppantam. itu potuvuṭaimai uruciya nāṭukaḷ oṉṟupaṭṭu iyaṅkuvataṟku etiriṭaiyākac caṉanāyaka nāṭukaḷ irukka vēṇṭumeṉṉum aṭip paṭaiyaik koṇṭatu. ivvuṭaṉpaṭikkaiyil campantappaṭṭa oru nāṭṭai uruciyā tākkiṉāl maṟṟaiya nāṭukaḷ utavikēṭkappaṭā malē utavikkuc cellutal vēṇṭum.
atlāntik cācaṉam: itu cēṭcilum amerikkak kuṭiyaracut talaivar urū° vēlṭum 1941 āka°ṭu 14il oru pōrk kappalil atlāntik kaṭalil cantittuk kaiyoppamiṭṭa oru cācaṉam. ulakil oru cātiyār iṉṉoru cātiyārai valuviṟkaṭṭiyāḷutal kūṭāteṉpatu itaṉ curukkamākum.
apē (Abey): periya kiṟittuva maṭaṅkaḷukkum kōvilkaḷōṭiṇaikkap paṭṭirunta maṭaṅkaḷukkum vaḻaṅkum peyar. immaṭaṅkaḷil kiṟittuva tuṟavikaḷ vāḻntārkaḷ. ivarkaḷ apoṭ(Abbot) eṉṉum maṭat talaivariṉ āḷukaikkuṭpaṭṭiruntārkaḷ. kaṉṉit tuṟavikaḷ ape° (Abbess) eṉṉum talaiviyiṉ āḷukaikkuṭpaṭṭiruntārkaḷ.
appō°talar naṭapaṭikaḷ: kiṟittuva vētattil putiya ēṟpāṭṭiluḷḷa aintāvatu nūl; irupatteṭṭatikāraṅkaḷ koṇṭatu. iyēcuviṉ varalāṟākiya cuvicēṣaṅkaḷil oṉṟai iyaṟṟiya lūkkā eṉpavarē itaiyum eḻutiṉār eṉak karutappaṭukiṟatu.
ampulaṉ°: itu kāyamaṭaintavarkaḷai vaittiya cālaikaḷukku eṭuttuc celvatu pōṉṟa vaṇṭi. pōrk kālaṅkaḷil itu kāyampaṭṭavar kaḷukku mutalutavi aḷittu avarai vaittiyacālaikaḷukku eṭuttuc cellap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum. itil ceñciluvai aṭaiyāḷamiṭappaṭ ṭirukkum. pireñcuc cēṉaiyaic cērnta pāraṉ cīṉ lāri eṉpavarē ivvaṇṭiyai 1792il pōril mutaṉ muṟai payaṉpaṭuttiṉār. piṉ ellā nāṭukaḷum itaṉaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉa. ampulaṉ° ōṭṭupavarum atil vēlai ceypavarum naṭunilaiyiṉarākak karutappaṭa vēṇṭu meṉa 1864il vakukkappaṭṭa ceṉīvā uṭaṉpaṭikkai kūṟukiṉṟatu.
ammai: oru vakait toṟṟunōy. itil ciṉṉammai (Chicken Pox), periyammai (Small pox), taṭṭammai (Measles) eṉa mūṉṟu vakaiyuṇṭu. periyammai mikakkoṭiyatu. itu varāmal taṭuppataṟku ammaip pāl kuttappaṭukiṟatu.
ariya° matam: (Arainism) alakcāntiriyāvil vāḻnta āriya° (Arius) eṉpavar (ki.pi. 256-336) kiṟittunātar tēvaṉ allar; maṉitaril teyvattaṉmai yuṭaiyavar eṉap pōtittār. ik koḷkai ivar peyarāl aṟiyappaṭakiṟatu.
arttacāttiram: mauriya cantirakuptaṉiṉ (ki.mu. 325 - 297) mantiriyāka virunta kauṭaliyar allatu cāṇakkiyar allatu viṭṭuṇukuptar eṉpavarāl ceyyappaṭṭa āṭci nūl.
alaṅkārak kaṭai: (Beauty Shop) mēl nāṭukaḷil peṇkaḷiṉ veḷit tōṟṟattai aḻakupaṭuttum nilaiyaṅkaḷ palavirukkiṉṟaṉa. aikkiya amerikkāvil māttiram ēṟakkuṟaiya 60,000 kaṭaikaḷirukkiṉṟaṉa. kai viral nakaṅkaḷ, tōl, pal, kai mutalivaṟṟai ivai aḻakākat tōṟṟamaḷikkac ceykiṉṟaṉa.
alrācoṉik°: (Ultasonics) maṉitaṉuṭaiya kātukkuk kēṭka muṭiyāta olikaḷaip paṟṟiya ārāycci. oru noṭikku 15,000 alai atirvu (Oscillations)kku mēṟpaṭṭa oli maṉitaṉuṭaiya kātukkukkēḷātu. mikak kuṟainta atirvuḷḷa ōcaiyum kātukaḷukkuk kēṭkātu. ivai paṟṟiya ārāycci ippeyar peṟum.
āṅkilam: itu 270,000,000kku mēṟpaṭṭa makkaḷ vaḻaṅkum moḻi. im moḻiyai vaḻaṅkuvōruḷ 150,600,000kku mēṟpaṭṭōr aikkiya amerikkāviluḷar.
āriya camācam: itu tayāṉanta caracuvati eṉṉum kucarāttup pirāmaṇat tuṟaviyāl 1875il niṟuvappaṭṭa oru nilaiyam. itu cātimata vēṟṟumai kaḷai oppukkoḷvatillai.
ālaṅkaṭṭi: mēkattiliruntu viḻum kaṉatta paṉikkaṭṭit tuṇukku. iv vakai ālaṅkaṭṭi mirutuvāy ciṟu veṇ paṉittuṇukkukaḷaip pōṉṟirukkum.
iraṭcaṇiya cēṉai: (Salvation army) itu iṅkilāntil metaṭi°ṭ pātiriyāyirunta villiyam pūt eṉpavarāl 1865il amaikkappaṭṭa caṅkam. itaṟkuc cēṉai eṉṟu peyariṭappaṭṭiruppatāl itaṉ talaivarkaḷaic ceṉaraleṉṟum itu kūṭumiṭaṅkaḷaip pāḷaiyam (Barracks) eṉṟum vaḻaṅkuvar. matappaṟṟillāta makkaḷ uḷḷattaik kavar vataṟkāka ic cēṉaiyiṉ pōrvīrar pōl uṭuppaṇintu koṭi paṟakka viṭṭuk koṇṭu pāṇṭu vāttiyattuṭaṉ pavaṉi varuvar. iccēṉai 89 nāṭukaḷil amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.ivarkaḷ 123 pattirikaikaḷai 81 moḻikaḷil veḷiyiṭukiṟārkaḷ.
irattac cuṟṟōṭṭam: irutayam irattattai iṟaikkiṟatu. irattam mutalil nūraiyīralukkuc celkiṟatu. aṅku atu pirāṇavāyuviṉāl nirappap paṭukiṟatu. piṉpu atu itayattukkuc celkiṟatu. piṉpu atu irattak kuḻāy vaḻiyākac celkiṟatu. itu ciṟiya ciṟiya irattak kuḻāykaḷ vaḻi yākac ceṉṟu tacai nārkaḷukkup pirāṇavāyuvaik koṭuttuviṭṭuk kaḻivup poruḷai vāṅkik koṇṭu akaṉṟu akaṉṟu celkiṉṟa vēyiṉ° (Veins) eṉṉum kuḻāykaḷ vaḻiyāka itayattai aṭaintu nuraiyīralai aṭaikiṟatu. aṅku atu kaḻivup poruḷkaḷai nīrāvi yākavum kārpaṉ ṭai ākcaiṭ ākavum veḷiyē viṭṭu viṭṭup putiya pirāṇavāyuvaip peṟukiṟatu.
irattak kaṭṭi (Abscess): tōṟpuraiyiṉ kīḻ āḻattil tīya nōyk kirumi kaḷiṉ toṟṟiṉāl uṇṭāvatu. avai peruki nañcai veḷiyē viṭuvatāl avviṭattil aḻaṟciyum tiraṭciyum uṇṭākiṟatu.
irattam: mikutiyāṉa uyirkaḷukku uṭal muḻumaikkum uṇavaik koṇṭu ceṉṟu kaḻivup poruḷkaḷai veḷiyēṟṟum tiravap poruḷ. itil pirāṇavāyuvai uṟiñcum oru poruḷ uṇṭu. ipporuḷ irattattiluḷḷa civappu aṇukkaḷilirukkiṉṟatu. civappu aṇukkaḷ piḷā°mā eṉṉum tiravattil mitakkiṉṟaṉa. cila aṇukkaḷ veṇ ṇiṟamuṭaiyaṉa. avai aṇuk kirumikaḷ nuḻaintāl avaṟṟai uṇṭuviṭukiṉṟaṉa.
irāci: vāṉil cūriyaṉ celvatākat tōṉṟum vītiyākiya irāci maṇṭalam ovvoṉṟum 300 aḷavuḷḷa paṉṉiraṇṭu pākaṅkaḷākkappaṭṭu appākaṅkaḷ irācikaḷeṉappaṭum: avai mēcam, iṭapam, mituṉam, kaṭakam, ciṅkam, kaṉṉi, tulām, viruccikam, taṉucu, makaram, kumpam, mīṉam eṉpaṉa. inta irācikaḷil amaiyum naṭcattiraṅkaḷ āṭu mutaliya vaṭivuṭaiyaṉavākat tōṉṟutalāl ippeyarkaḷ uṇṭāyiṉa. kuḻantai piṟakkum pōtu utayattil (aṭivāṉil) uḷḷa irāci ceṉma ilakkiṉa meṉappaṭum.
irāp pōcaṉam: ciluvaiyil aṟaiyappaṭuvataṟku mutalnāḷ iravu kiṟittu nātar cīṭarkaḷuṭaṉiruntu uṇavukoṇṭapoḻutu appattaiyum tirāṭcai iracattaiyum toṭṭuk kaṭavuḷukku naṉṟi celuttiviṭṭu “itu eṉatu uṭal, itu eṉatu irattam, itai eṉ niṉaivāka iyaṟṟuṅ kaḷ” eṉṟu kūṟiṉār. itai “yūkkari°ṭ” eṉṟum kūṟuvar. yūk kari°ṭ eṉṉum kirēkka colliṉ poruḷ naṉṟi kūṟal. itai āṅkilattil “kammūṉiyaṉ”eṉpar. atu tamiḻil naṟkaruṇai eṉappaṭum. urōmaṉ kattōlikkar itaṉai “mā°”eṉpar. purōkitar appattaiyum tirāṭcai iracattaiyum cepaṅ kūṟik karttariṉ uṭalākavum iratta mākavum māṟṟi aṭiyārkku vaḻaṅkuvatu aitīkam. itai urōmaṉ kattōlikkar nāṭōṟum allatu vārantōṟum peṟuvārāyiṉum yēcunātar uyirtteḻunta ī°ṭar nāḷaṉṟu peṟṟāka vēṇṭum.
irumal: mūccuk kuḻāyiluḷḷa caḷiyaiyō allatu aṅku cērnta piṟa poruḷkaḷaiyō appuṟappaṭuttuvataṟku mēṟkoḷḷum ceyal irumal eṉappaṭukiṟatu. piṟa kāraṇaṅkaḷāl uṇṭākum irumal tīmai payappatu.
iḷampiḷḷaivātam: kuḻantaikaḷukku varum toṟṟu nōykaḷuḷ mikap payaṅkaramāṉatu; kai kālkaḷai muṭamākkak kūṭiyatu. innōy mikuti yum amerikkāvil kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. itu oruvakai viṭakkirumiyāl (vaira°) uṇṭākiṟatu. innōy varāmal taṭuppu maruntu celuttik koḷḷalām.
iṟakukaḷ: paṟavaikaḷiṉ iṟakukaḷ pallivakaikaḷiṉ cetilkaḷiliruntu vaḷarcciyaṭaintavai. oru iṟakil teṉṉōlai pōṉṟa pala alaku kaḷum, alakukaḷil mayir pōṉṟa alakukaḷumuṇṭu. puṟāviṉ iṟaku oṉṟil ēṟakkuṟaiya 1,200 periya alakukaḷum 990,000 ciṟiya alaku kaḷumuṇṭu.
iṉkā (Inca): teṉṉamerikkāvil peru, arccaṇṭaiṉā, cilli mutaliya nāṭukaḷil muṟkālattil vāḻnta makkaḷ ippeyar peṟuvar. ivar kaḷiṉ aracaṉ iṉkā eṉappaṭṭāṉ. mekcikkōvil vāḻnta paḻaiya makkaḷ a°ṭek° eṉappaṭṭārkaḷ.
iṉkuviciṣaṉ: kattōlikka matakkoḷkaikaḷai nampātavarkaḷait, taṇṭippataṟkākap pōp 9ām kirikori 1231il koṇṭu vanta caṭṭam. iccaṭṭattiṉpaṭi camayattai nampātavarkaḷ tīyiliṭṭum, cittiravatai ceytum taṇṭikkappaṭṭārkaḷ. yōṉ ov āk eṉṉum vīrappeṇ maṇi taṇṭaṉai peṟṟatu iccaṭṭattiṉ paṭiyē yākum.
ī°ṭar: kiṟittunātar uyirtteḻuntatai niṉaṉavūṭṭum viḻā. itu mārc mātam 21ām nāḷilō ataṟkup piṟakō varum pūraṇaikku aṭutta mutal ñāyiṟṟukkiḻamai koṇṭāṭappaṭukiṟatu.
uṇṇāviratam: itu muṟkālam mutal ellāc camayattavarālum kaik koḷḷappaṭṭu vantatu; iṉṟum cila camayattavarāl kaikkoḷḷap paṭṭu varukiṉṟatu. paṇṭaik kālattil mekcikkō, peru, pāpilōṉ, acīriyā, ekiptu, pāla°tīṉam, arēpiyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷilum, kelṭu tiyutēṉiya makkaḷiṭaiyum ivvaḻakkam kāṇappaṭṭatu. intu, pautta, camaṇa, mukamatiya, kiṟittuva, yūtamatattiṉariṭaiyum itu iṉṟum iruntu varukiṟatu.
uram (pacaḷai): nilattiliruntu tāvaraṅkaḷ uṟiñci eṭuttukkoṇṭa iracāyaṉap poruḷkaḷai īṭu ceyvataṟkāka nilattukku uramiṭap paṭukiṟatu. urattil naiṭraciṉum pācuvaramum aṭaṅkiyirukkum.
etir aṭiyiṭam: (Antipodes) nām niṟpataṟkuk kīḻē pūmiyiṉ maṟupuṟatti luḷḷa iṭam.
eppiril: āṇṭil nāṉkāvatu mātam. ippeyar virital eṉṉum peyar paṭum. ilāttiṉ colliṉiṉṟum piṟantatu. ikkālam mutal pūkkaḷum taḷirkaḷum viraivil virikiṉṟaṉa.
eri naṭcattirakkal: eri naṭcattiram periyatāṉāl muḻuvatum erivataṉ muṉ atu pūmiyai aṭaiyalām. avvāṟu viḻum kaṟkaḷ eri naṭcat tirakkaṟkaḷ eṉappaṭum. avai pūmiyai aṇuka aṇukak kāṟṟiṉ taṭai mikuvatāl viḻum vēkam taṭaippaṭum; muṉpōl erivatillai. avai tuṇṭukaḷāka uṭaintuviṭukiṉṟaṉa. cila camayaṅkaḷil periya naṭcattirak kaṟkaḷ viḻuvatumuṇṭu. 1908il periya naṭcattirakkal caipīriyāvil viḻuntapōtu 25 mail cuṟṟiluḷḷa kāṭukaḷ aḻintu viṭṭaṉa. ēṟakkuṟaiya 4000 āṇṭukaḷiṉ muṉ aricōṉāvil oru periya vāṉak kal viḻuntatāl uṇṭāṉa paḷḷam 570 aṭi āḻamum 4/5 mail viṭṭamumuḷḷatu.
eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷ: (Metoer) vāl naṭcattiraṅkaḷ kavarcciyiṉ kāraṇamāka ētāvatu oru periya kirakattaiyō cūriyaṉaiyō aṇukalām. aṅkuḷḷa ellaikkumēl aṇukiṉāl avai uṭaikiṉṟaṉa. at tuṇṭukaḷē eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷākiṉṟaṉa. vēṟu aṇṭaṅkaḷ uṭain tum eri naṭcattiraṅkaḷ uṇṭākalām. ivai puviyīrppiṉāl vāyu maṇṭalattil nuḻaiyumāṉāl cekkaṇṭukku 40 mailukku atikap paṭṭa vēkattil varum. appoḻutu kāṟṟilē uṇṭākum urāyvi ṉāl 40000 veppamaṭaintu erikiṉṟaṉa. veḷiccam pulappaṭuvatu 80 mail uyarattilākum.perumpālum pūmiyai aṭaiyumuṉ avai erintuviṭukiṉṟaṉa. nāḷtōṟum ilaṭcak kaṇakkāṉa eri naṭcat tiraṅkaḷ pūmiyil viḻukiṉṟaṉa.
erimalai: pūmikkuḷḷirukkum urukiya kaṟkuḻampu veḷiyē taḷḷap paṭuvatāl kuvintu kūmpu vaṭivākavirukkum malaikaḷ erimalaikaḷ eṉappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. erimalaikaḷ uṟaṅkum erimalaikaḷ viḻi eri malaikaḷ eṉa iruvakaippaṭum.
elumpu: mutukelumpuḷḷa uyirkaḷiṉ taṭimayamāṉa kūṭṭai elumpu eṉki ṟōm. itu kālciyam po°pēṟ eṉṉum iracāyaṉap poruḷāl periyatum uṇṭākkappaṭṭuḷḷatu. elumpiluḷḷa cila celkaḷ paṭai paṭaiyākap paṭintu elumpai uṇṭākkukiṉṟaṉa.
aintām paṭai: oru nāṭṭiluḷḷavarkaḷē an nāṭṭiṟku etirāka vēlai ceyyum pakaivarkaḷukku utava muṉvariṉ avarkaḷ aintām paṭai yiṉar eṉappaṭuvar. i°pēyiṉil uḷnāṭṭuk kuḻappattiṉ pōtu pirāṅkō 4 aṇiyāka niṉṟu māṭriṭ nakarait tākkiṉār. pirāṅkō viṉ aṉutāpikaḷ aracāṅkattuḷ iruntapaṭiyē kuḻappaṅkaḷai uṇṭākkiṉārkaḷ. ivvāṟu ceytavarkaḷ aintām paṭaiyiṉareṉap paṭṭārkaḷ.
aimperuṅkāppiyaṅkaḷ: cilappatikāram, maṇimēkalai, cīvakacintāmaṇi, vaḷaiyāpati, kuṇṭalakēci eṉpaṉa. piṉṉiraṇṭu nūlkaḷum maṟaintupōyiṉa.
oruppaṭi: (Uniform) pōr vīrar, cāraṇar, poli° pōṉṟa kūṭṭattiṉar aṇiyum orēvakai uṭuppu. piriṭṭicār 1880il intiya turuppu kaḷukkuk kākki uṭuppiṉai vakuttaṉar. kākki eṉṉum intu°tāṉic col puḻuti niṟam eṉṟu poruḷpaṭum. pōyar pōrukkup piṉ kākki uṭuppu aṇivatu ulaka muḻumaiyum paraviyatu. ippoḻutu araciyaṟ karuttuc campantamāṉa koḷkaikaḷai viḷakkac cila kūṭṭattiṉar civappu, kaṟuppu mutaliya uṭaikaḷaiyu maṇikiṉṟaṉar.
olimpik āṭṭaṅkaḷ: nāṉku āṇṭukaḷukku orumuṟai naṭaipeṟum ulaka āṭṭappōṭṭikaḷ. ivai paṇṭaik kālak kirēkkariṉ tēcīya viḻāviṉ maṟumalarcciyākum. ivviḻāvai avarkaḷ olimpiyā eṉṉum camaveḷiyil ciya° eṉṉum teyvattiṉ vaḻipāṭāka naṭatti vantamaiyāl olimpik āṭṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum peyaruṇṭāyiṟṟu.
oṭṭam tuḷḷal: kēraḷa nāṭṭil vaḻaṅkum pukaḻpeṟṟa nāṭṭuk kūttu. itu orāḷ naṭaṉam. naṭaṉamāṭupavar īraṭippāṭal oṉṟaip pāṭi ataṉ karuttai apinayaṅkaḷāl kuṟippiṭuvar. avarukkup piṉpuṟam niṟkum mattaḷakkārar appāṭalai maṟupaṭiyum pāṭi mattaḷamaṭippar. avar pāṭi muṭintatum naṭaṉakkārar aṭutta īraṭip pāṭalaip pāṭuvar.
orkaṇṭi: (Organdy) ilēcum, kampipōṉṟa viṟaippum oḷi pukaviṭum tiṟaṉumuḷḷa oruvakait tuṇi. orkaṇṭi eṉṉumiṭattil ceyyappaṭu talāl itaṟku ippeyar vaḻaṅkukiṉṟatu.
oḷavai illam: ceṉṉaiyil aṭaiyāṟṟiluḷḷa ōr illam. iṅku ātaravaṟṟa ciṟuvar ciṟumikaḷait tīya paḻakkaṅkaḷil viṭāmal pēṇik kāppāṟṟappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉar.
kaṭalnīriṉ aḻuttam: kaṭaluḷ 15,000 aṭi āḻattil oru catura aṅkula iṭattil tākkum aḻuttam 2½ toṉ. ivvaḷavaḻuttamuḷḷa iṭatti lum ataṉ kīḻum mīṉ vakaikaḷ vāḻkiṉṟaṉa. avaṟṟai mēlē koṇṭu vantāl aḻuttam kuṟaivatāl avai veṭittuviṭum. āḻkaṭal mīṉ kaḷukku veḷiccattai uṇṭākkum uṟuppukkaḷ uṭampiluṇṭu.
kampaḷi: palavakai vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mayir kampaḷi eṉappaṭukiṟatu. kampaḷi vakaikaḷil mukkiyamuṭaiyatu cemmaṟiyāṭṭiṉ mayir. cila veḷḷāṭ ṭiṉ mayiraiyum kampaḷi eṉpatuṇṭu. tipettu nāṭṭu veḷḷāṭṭiṉ mayir kāṣmīr eṉavum, aṅkōrā veḷḷāṭṭiṉ mayir mōkēr eṉa vum pēru nāṭṭiluḷḷa alpakkā eṉṉum vilaṅkiṉ mayir alpakkā eṉavum vaḻaṅkum. oṭṭakattiṉ mayirum melliya uṭaikaḷukkup payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.
kuṭal: oṉṟarai aṭiyuḷḷa maṉitavayiṟṟil 25 aṭi ciṟu kuṭalum, 5 aṭi peruṅkuṭalum aṭaṅkik kiṭakkiṉṟaṉa.
kuṟumpaṉṟi: itu kuṟumāṉ, cuṇṭumāṉ eṉavum aṟiyappaṭum. kuḷampuḷḷa pirāṇikaḷil mikac ciṟiyatu. 10-12 aṅkulamuyara mirukkum. itu intiyā, ilaṅkai, āppirikkā, malāyā mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭum.
kēpiḷ: (Cable) miṉ kaṭattum kampikaḷ palavaṟṟai oṉṟu cērttuk kāppiṭṭavaṭam. kāppukku mēlum ōr uṟai irukkum. ivvuṟaiyaik kārīyattiṉāl ceyvatu vaḻakkam. itu kaṭalnīr, maṇ mutaliyavaṟṟāl kēpiḷ arikkappaṭṭu viṭāmal pātukākkiṟatu.

kailāyam: tipettiluḷḷa malai; imayamalait toṭaraic cērntatu; uyaram 22,028 aṭi; cuṟṟaḷavu iraṇṭu mail. itaṉai intukkaḷum pauttarum tuhymaiyiṟ ciṟanta iṭamākak koḷvar.
kokkippuḻu: cātāraṇamāka oru kokkippuḻu maṉita uṭaliṟ pukunta aintu vāraṅkaḷil muṭṭaiyiṭat toṭaṅkum. oru nāḷaikku oru puḻu 25,000 - 35,000 muṭṭaikaḷiṭum. ippaṭi nāḷtōṟum iṭṭukkoṇṭirukkum. pala puḻukkaḷ 5,6 mātam uyirōṭirukkum maṟṟum pala 5, 6 āṇṭukaḷ uyirōṭirukkum. 16 āṇṭukaḷ uyirō ṭirunta puḻukkaḷumuṇṭu.

cama aḻuttakkōṭu: (Isobar) tēcappaṭattil kāṟṟiṉ aḻuttam camamāka uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷaic cērkkum kōṭu. ikkōṭukaḷ oru kuṟippiṭṭa veḷiyil allatu ulakam muḻuvatilum oru kuṟippiṭṭa kālattil nilaviya aḻuttattiṉ carācariyaik kāṭṭa varaiyappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
cama iravukaḷ: (Equinoxes) pūmattiya rēkaiyil vāḻpavarkaḷukku ellā nāṭkaḷilum iravu nēramum pakal nēramum camamāka irukkum. itē pōl cūriyaṉ pūmattiya rēkaiyait tāṇṭum nāṭkaḷil mārccu 23, cepṭampar 23 tētikaḷil pūmiyiṉ ellā iṭaṅkaḷilum iravu pakal camamākavirukkum. inta nāṭkaḷ cama iravukaḷ eṉappaṭum.
camakkāḷam: parutti nūliṉāl ceyyappaṭum virippuc camakkāḷa meṉavum urōmattiṉāl neyyappaṭuvatu kampaḷameṉavum paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
calpā maruntukaḷ: (Sulpa drugs) uṭaliṟ pukuntu nōyai viḷaikkum nuṇ kirumikaḷiṉ vaḷarcciyait taṭaiceytu nōyai oḻikkum taṉmaiyaip peṟṟuḷḷa cila iracāyaṉa maruntup poruḷkaḷukku ip peyar vaḻaṅkum. nilakkariyiliruntu peṟappaṭum cila poruḷkaḷiliruntu ivai tayārikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.
cavukku maram: itil 35 vakaikaḷuṇṭu. ivaṟṟil perumpālāṉavai ā°tirēliyāviṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. maṟṟavai malāyā, niyū kaliṭōṉiyāviṟ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. cavukku maram intiyāvukku 19ām nuhṟṟāṇṭil ā°tirēliyāviliruntu koṇṭu varappaṭṭatu. cavukkiṉ ilaikaḷ kācōvāri eṉṉum kōḻiyiṉ iṟakukaḷaip pōṉṟu tōṉṟuvatāl ataṟkuk kācuvāriṉēci eṉa viññāṉap peyar iṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
cākkalēṭṭu: (Chocolate) itu kokkō vitaiyiliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. toṭakkattil mekcikkō nāṭṭiṉar kokkō vitaiyiliruntu oru vita pāṉattaic ceytu kuṭittuvantaṉar. avarkaḷiṭamiruntu i°pēyiṉ nāṭṭavar kokkōp pāṉam ceyyak kaṟṟaṉar. piṉ cākkalēṭṭut tayārittaṉar. ēṟakkuṟaiya nūṟāṇṭukaḷāka i°pāṉiyar itai irakaciyamāka vaittiruntaṉar. piṉ ittāli, pirāṉ°, cermaṉi mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkuc cākkalēṭṭuc ceyyum muṟai paraviyatu. 1657il ilaṇṭaṉil cākkalēṭṭu oru pireñcukkārāl mutaṉmutal viṟkappaṭṭatu. 1700il pāl kalantu cākkalēṭṭuc ceyyum muṟaiyai āṅkilēyar kaṇṭupiṭittaṉar. ulakil cākkalēṭṭai mikutiyāka uṭkoḷḷum nāṭu amerikkā. kuṟainta aḷavil mikunta cakti tarum uṇavu cākkalēṭṭu. ulakil cākkalēṭṭai mikutiyākac ceyyum nāṭukaḷ teṉṉamerikkā, mēṟkintiyat tīvukaḷ, āppirikkāviluḷḷa kōlṭukō°ṭṭu (kāṉā).

pañcāṅkam: (Almanac) nāḷ, vāram, mātam, āṇṭu mutaliyavaṟṟōṭu amāvāci, pūraṇai, cantiraṉiṉ celavu viḻākkaḷ pōṉṟavaṟṟaik kāṭṭum nuhl.

pātippiṉmai: (Immunity) ammai, neruppuk kāyccal, piḷēk, pōṉṟa nōykaḷ pātiyātapaṭi maruntukaḷ ūcimulam pukuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉāl uṭalil an nōykaḷai etirkkum cakti uṇṭākiṟatu. oru muṟai innōy kaṇṭavarkaḷukku annōykaḷiṉ pātippiṉmai uṇṭākiṟatu.
periya uppu veḷikaḷ: (Great salt Plains) aikkiya amerikkāvil oklakōmā (Oklahoma) eṉṉumiṭattiluḷḷa uppu veḷi eṭṭu mail nīḷamum āṟu mail akalamumuḷḷatu. iṅku oḷiyiṉāl kaṇṇaik kūcac ceyyum veṇṇiṟa uppuḷatu.
paipiḷ: kiṟittavarkaḷiṉ vētam. itil paḻaiya ēṟpāṭu, putiya ēṟpāṭu eṉa iraṇṭu pakutikaḷuṇṭu. paḻaiya ēṟpāṭu epirēyamoḻiyilum putiya ēṟpāṭu kirēkka moḻiyilum eḻutappaṭṭiruntaṉa. paḻaiya ēṟpāṭu ki.mu. 300 mutal ki.pi. 300 varai kirēkka moḻiyil moḻi peyarkkappaṭṭatu. ki.pi. 2ām nuhṟṟāṇṭil paipiḷ muḻumaiyum ilāttiṉil moḻi peyarkkappaṭṭatu. 14ām nuhṟṟāṇṭiṉiṟutiyil vaikkiḷiv eṉpavar paipiḷ muḻuvataiyum āṅkilattil moḻi peyarttār. itu ēṟakkuṟaiya 200 moḻikaḷil moḻi peyarkkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.
malaikkiḻavam: (Old man of the mountain) itu niyuhām caiyaril (aikkiya amerikkā) veḷḷai malaiyiṉ ceṅkuttāṉa pāṟaiyil oru maṉita mukattiṉ pakkattōṟṟam kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. neṟṟiyil vilvaṭivāṉa puruvam 100 aṭi uyaramuḷḷatu.
maṟaiyum nīruṟṟu: (Sinking Creek) itu kentakki (aikkiya amerikkā) yiluḷḷa nīruṟṟu. itu caṭutiyil nilattiṉkīḻ maṟaintu mikap pala mailkaḷ ceṉṟu malaikkukai oṉṟiṉ aṭiyāl veḷivarukiṉṟatu. itu nāṭakattil tiraiyiṉ kāṭci pōṉṟatu.
malēriyāc curam: itu aṉōpili° eṉṉum nuḷampuk kaṭiyiṉāluṇṭā kiṟatu. nuḷampu kaṭittu irattattai uṟiñcumpōtu nōyk kirumikaḷai uṭampil pukuttiviṭukiṉṟatu. ik kirumikaḷ irattattiṟkiṭantu perukutalāl malēriyāc curamuṇṭākiṟatu.
mūḷai: narampu mayamāṉa ticukkaḷiṉ tiraṭci. itu uṭampiṉ toḻiṟ pāṭṭaik kaṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟatu. itu pulaṉ uṟuppukkaḷ ceytikaḷai aṟintu eṉṉa ceyyavēṇṭumeṉpatai tacainārkaḷukku (Muscles) aṟivikkiṉṟatu.
mellum piciṉ: (Chewing gum) cappōṭṭā eṉṉum cīmai iluppai marappāliruntu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu. cappōṭṭā veppa maṇṭala amerikka maram.

cevvāykkum viyāḻaṉukkumiṭaiyil ciṟukiraṅkaḷ vaḷaiyam pōl cūḻntirukkiṉṟaṉa.
kirakaṅkaḷaiyum cūriyaṉaiyum cūḻntu kaṭikārattaippōla naṭcattira maṇṭalamirukkiṉṟatu. ataṉ naṭcattiraṅkaḷ neruṅkik kāṇappaṭum pakuti pālvīti maṇṭalameṉap paṭukiṟatu.
namakkup pulappaṭum naṭcattira maṇṭalattaippōla pala āyiram naṭcattira maṇṭalaṅkaḷuṇṭu

cantiraṉiṉ orupakkam māttiram eppoḻutum eṅkaḷukkut terikiṟatu

āṅkilap paḻamoḻikaḷ
1. Where the bee sucks honey, the spider sucks poison
ī tēṉuṟiñcumiṭattil cilanti nañcai uṟiñcukiṟatu.
2. When war begins hell opens
yuttam toṭaṅkumpōtu narakam tiṟakkappaṭukiṟatu
3. When children stand quiet they have done some ill 
ciṟuvar pēcātu niṉṟāl avarkaḷ ētum kuṟumpu ceytiruppārkaḷ
4. Wake not a sleeping lion
uṟaṅkukiṟa ciṅkattai eḻuppātē
5. Two ears to one tongue, therefore hear twice as much as you speak
iraṇṭu kātukaḷukku oru nāvirukkiṟatu; ākavē pēcuvatilum iru maṭaṅku atikam kēṭka vēṇṭum.
6. To run with the hare and hunt with hounds
muyalōṭum ōṭi nāyōṭum vēṭṭaiyāṭuvatu
7. Thrift is phliosophers stone
cikkaṉameṉpatu iracavātak kuḷikai
8. The worst wheel of a cart creeks most
mikamōcamāṉa vaṇṭiccakkaram atikam kiṟīcciṭukiṟatu
9. The higher up, the greater fall
uyaram evvaḷavu peritu, avvaḷavukku viḻukaiyum peritāka virukkum
10. The eye that sees all things else sees not itself
ellāvaṟṟaiyum kāṇum kaṇ taṉṉaik kāṇamāṭṭātu.
11. The crow thinks her own bird fairest
taṉṉiṉappaṟavai aḻakiyateṉak kākam niṉaikkiṟatu.
12. Burnt child dreads the fire
cūṭupaṭṭa kuḻantai neruppaik kaṇṭu payappaṭum
13. The bough that bear most hang lowest
atikam kāytta maram atikam vaṇaṅki niṟkum
14. Strike while iron is hot
cūṭāyirukkumpōtu irumpai aṭi
15. Step by step the ladder ascends
paṭippaṭiyāka ēṇi uyarukiṟatu
16. Silence is the best ornament of a woman
amaiti peṇṇukkuc ciṟanta āparaṇam
17. Praise to the face is open disgrace
mukattukku nērē pukaḻtal pakiraṅka avamāṉam
18. Pleasure has a sting in its tail
cukāṉupavaṅkaḷiṉ vālil koṭukkuṇṭu
19. Never two late to learn
paṭippataṟku eppavum kālam pōkavillai
20. Lawers houses are bulit on the heads of fools
niyāyavātikaḷiṉ vīṭukaḷ mūṭariṉ talaiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭiruk kiṉṟaṉa.
21. Truth has a good face, but bad clothes
uṇmaikku aḻakiya mukamuṇṭu, aḻakiya uṭai illai.
22. A dog will not howl if you beat him with a bone
elumpāl aṭittāl nāy ūḷaiyiṭātu
23. A fox is not taken twice in the same snare
orumuṟai paṭṭa valaiyil iraṇṭāvatu muṟai atē nari paṭamāṭṭātu
24. A good wife and health is a man’s best wealth
oru nalla maṉaiviyum tēkacukamum maṉitaṉuṭaiya ciṟanta celvam.
25. A great dowry is a bed full of brambles
atika cītaṉam paṭukkaiyil niṟainta muḷ
26. A small leak will sink a ship 
ciṟiya tuvāram periya kappalai āḻttum
27. Bees that have honey in their mouths have stings in their tails
vāyil tēṉ vaittirukkum tēṉīkkaḷukku vālil kuttum koṭukkuṇṭu
28. Better an egg today than a hen tomorrow
nāḷai kiṭaikkum pēṭṭuk kōḻiyilum pārkka iṉṟu kiṭaikkum muṭṭaimēl.
29. Beware of silent dog and still water
amaitiyāka niṟkum nāykkum amaitiyāṉa nīrukkum eccarikkaiyāka iru.
30. Bitter pills may have wholesome effect
kaippāṉa kuḷikaikaḷil nalla kuṇamirukkalām.
31. Diet cures more than doctors
maruttuvarilum pārkka uṇavu nōyait tīrkkiṟatu.
32. Great talkers are great liars
atikam pēcuvōr periya poyyar.
33. Great winds blows upon high hills
peruṅkāṟṟu uyarnta malaikaḷil vīcukiṟatu.
34. Idle brains are the devils workshops
cōmpēṟi mūḷaikaḷ pēyiṉ toḻiṟcālaikaḷ.
35. Hares may pull dead lions by the beard
cetta ciṅkaṅkaḷiṉ tāṭiyai muyalkaḷāl piṭittiḻukka muṭiyum.
36. A fool may ask more questions in an hour than a wise man can answer in seven years.
putticāli ēḻu āṇṭukaḷil viṭaikāṇa muṭiyāta kēḷvikaḷai oru mūṭaṉ oru maṇi nērattil kēṭkalām.
vaiṭṭamiṉkaḷ
vaiṭṭamiṉkaḷ: uṭampu toḻiṟpaṭuvataṟku vēṇṭiyaṉavum cila uṇavu vakaikaḷiṟ kāṇappaṭuvaṉavumākiya oruvakaic cattukkaḷ. ivai ceyaṟkai muṟaikaḷil kuḷikaikaḷākavum, tiravavakaikaḷākavum ceyyappaṭṭu pōtiya vaiṭṭamiṉ cattillāta uṇavu koḷpavar kaḷukkuk koṭukkap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
ē(A) vaiṭṭamiṉ: itu uṭal vaḷarccikkum ticukkaḷiṉ vaḷarccikkum vēṇṭiyatu. itu mālaikkaṇ nōyait taṭukkiṟatu. itu pāl, muṭṭai, veṇṇey, mīṉeṇṇey, ilaipōl paccaiyum mañcaḷniṟamu muḷḷa tāvaravakaikaḷ, mañcaḷ niṟap paḻaṅkaḷ, vāḻaippaḻam, tōṭam paḻam, (ārēñcu) mutaliyavaṟṟiluṇṭu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ pi1(B1): itu narampukaḷ toḻilpaṭuvataṟku vēṇṭiyatu. itu illāviṭil peri peri eṉṉum nōy uṇṭākiṟatu. itu tāṉi yaṅkaḷ, muṭṭaiyiṉ mañcaṭkaru, āṭṭiṟaicci, māṭṭiṟaicci, koṭ mīṉ, cāṭiṉ mīṉ mutaliyavaṟṟiluṇṭu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ pi2(B2): itu G vaiṭṭamiṉ eṉavum paṭum. itu vaḷarccikkum tōl nōyiṉṟiruppataṟkum vēṇṭiyatu. itu veṇṇeyallāta maṟṟaiya uṇavup poruḷkaḷiluṇṭu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ ci: itu elumpaiyum pallaiyum palamākavirukkac cey kiṉṟatu. kāyaṅkaḷai āṟac ceykiṟatu; irattakkuḻāykaḷiṉ cuvar kaḷaip palamaṭaiyac ceykiṟatu. itu elumiccampaḻam, ārēñcuppaḻam, takkāḷi, paccai niṟamuḷḷa kīraivakaikaḷiluṇṭu. itu illāviṭil °kēvi eṉṉum coṟi karappāṉ nōy uṇṭākiṟatu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ ṭi: itu kaṇainōyai (rickets) taṭukkiṟatu. itu veyili liruntu atikam kiṭaikkiṟatu. eṇṇeykaḷ, pāl, muṭṭaiyiṉ mañcaṭkaru eṉpavaṟṟil itu uṇṭu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ ī: itaikkuṟittu atikam aṟiyappaṭavillai. itu iṉap perukkattoḻiṟ pāṭṭukku vēṇṭiyatu. itu kōtumai muḷai, muṭṭai, tāvara eṇṇey ivaikaḷiluṇṭu.
vaiṭṭamiṉ kē: irattam uṟaivataṟku itu tēvaiyāṉatu. itu kīraivakai kaḷilum, pāl, pāluṇavukaḷilumuṇṭu.
payiṟci viṉākkaḷ
I
1. nōrvēyil kāṇappaṭum pirāṇikaḷil etu kūṭṭamākac ceṉṟu taṟkolai purintu koḷkiṉṟatu ?

5. tēṉīkkaḷil kuttum koṭukkillātatetu ?

8. tirōcaṉ (Trojan) pōr ettaṉai āṇṭukaḷ naṭantatu ?
9. kirēkka teyvaṅkaḷ emmalaiyil uṟaintaṉa ?
10. viññāṉattil paḻamaiyuṭaiyatu etu eṉak karutappaṭukiṟatu?
11. pirāṇavāyuvaik kaṇṭupiṭittavar yār ?
12. vilaiyuyarnta (Precious) ulōkaṅkaḷ evai ?
13. mikap pāramāṉa taṉimam etu ?

15. cōk, calavaic cōṭā, epcam cālṭ eṉpavaṟṟiṉ viññāṉap peyarkaḷeṉṉa ?
16. cōṭiyam kuḷōraiṭ(Sodium chloride)-cukiṟō° (Sucrose) cōṭiyam-pai-kārpaṉēṭ, (Sodium-bi-Carbonate) eṉṉum viññāṉap peyarkaḷ cātāraṇamāka eppaṭi aṟiyappaṭum ?

21. kūḻmuṭṭai ēṉ keṭṭamaṇam vīcukiṟatu ?
22. taṇṇīr taṭippāṉatu eṉṟu eppoḻutu collukiṟōm?
23. mōṭṭār vaṇṭiyil kuḻāy mulam veḷivarum pukaiyil (Exhaust fumes) eṉṉa naccu vāyu irukkiṟatu ?
24. irumpu ēṉ turuppiṭikkiṟatu ?
